_meta.purpose: Game long-form text keyed by the string table the static database references.

entries.adler_skilldes::ga_adler_melee1_des: Wields his weapon and performs up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.
entries.adler_skilldes::ga_adler_melee2_des: Enters aim mode, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of single-target <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to the enemy in the crosshair.
entries.adler_skilldes::ga_adler_melee3_des: Plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.
entries.adler_skilldes::ga_adler_melee4_des: Grants Adler <NumGreen>1</> stack of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AdlerYe">Karma</> when Deliverance or Ignorance hits an enemy.<cf>Grants Adler <NumGreen>2</> stacks of Karma when Liberation hits an enemy.<cf>Max Karma stacks: <NumGreen>20</>.
entries.adler_skilldes::ga_adler_melee5_des: Triggers when casting Deliverance after a Critical Dodge. Dodges an attack with a quick dash, seizes the enemy's opening and swiftly swings his weapon, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area, reducing their Break.
entries.adler_skilldes::ga_adler_melee_backgroun: <Italic>A cane makes for quite the fitting accessory… a gentleman's weapon.</>
entries.adler_skilldes::ga_adler_passive_1_backg: <Italic>A meticulously pressed uniform and even hair, even in battle. The butler's first lesson is to maintain an impeccable appearance.</>
entries.adler_skilldes::ga_adler_passive_1_des: <TextHLT>Scorch Enhancement</>: Applies one of three random debuffs whenever Scorch is inflicted on a target: -20% ATK, -10% Esper Resistance, or +10% Break Efficiency, lasting for 15s. The same effect cannot stack.
entries.adler_skilldes::ga_adler_passive_2_backg: <Italic>"Sometimes a forceful strategy is preferable to lengthy negotiations."</>
entries.adler_skilldes::ga_adler_qte_des: This fight shall not be prolonged any longer. Aims and fires <NumGreen>1</> Compressed Round at the enemy, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area on hit.
entries.adler_skilldes::ga_adler_skill_backgroun: <Italic>"This commission… let's get to know our target first. We…"</><cf><Italic>"Coluccis! Roll out!"</><cf><Italic>"…Stay safe, I'll handle everything else."</>
entries.adler_skilldes::ga_adler_skill_des: Need help? Summons Sunya phantoms to strike enemies, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area, then inflicting <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> over time on enemies and granting active characters a shield with Blessing.<cf>Consumes all stacks of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&AdlerYe">Karma</> on skill cast. <NumGreen>Each</> stack consumed grants Adler <NumGreen>2%</> Skill DMG.
entries.adler_skilldes::ga_adler_star1_des: Grants Adler <NumGreen>20</> stacks of Karma when casting Tranquility.
entries.adler_skilldes::ga_adler_star2_des: Each stack of Karma grants Adler <NumGreen>3%</> DMG Bonus.
entries.adler_skilldes::ga_adler_star3_des: Increases the Shield of Blessing by <NumGreen>20%</>.
entries.adler_skilldes::ga_adler_star4_des: Absorbs a portion of overflow damage based on <NumGreen>50%</> of Adler's DEF when Blessing breaks.
entries.adler_skilldes::ga_adler_star5_des: Grants Adler <NumGreen>20</> Ultimate Energy when casting Tranquility.
entries.adler_skilldes::ga_adler_star6_des: Extends the duration of Blessing to <NumGreen>12</>s.
entries.adler_skilldes::ga_adler_starextra1_des: Increases the skill level of Deliverance, Evil's Bane, and Tranquility by <NumGreen>1</>.
entries.adler_skilldes::ga_adler_starextra2_des: Increases team's <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> by <NumGreen>10%</> while protected by Blessing.
entries.adler_skilldes::ga_adler_utraskill_backg: <Italic>The folks at Eibon like to guess the names of Adler's Sunyas. When they guess correctly, Adler rewards them with handmade desserts!</>
entries.adler_skilldes::ga_adler_utraskill_des: I wish not fight if possible. Summons Rupa, Vedana, Sanna, Vinnana, and Sankhara, <NumGreen>5</> Sunyas in total, to strike all enemy targets. Each target takes <NumGreen>5</> instances of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>. When only a single enemy remains on the field, Sunyas will perform a second strike, dealing a total of <NumGreen>10</> instances of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.
entries.cang_skilldes::ga_cang_melee1_des: Uses martial arts to perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.
entries.cang_skilldes::ga_cang_melee2_des: Hold Basic Attack to trigger Formless Words after the <NumGreen>1st</> and <NumGreen>2nd</> hits of Walk the Talk.<cf>Release the stick and hold Dodge to trigger Formless Words during battle.<cf>Fires <NumGreen>3</> incantation commands horizontally. After a brief delay, the commands detonate, with each dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area.
entries.cang_skilldes::ga_cang_melee3_des: Hold Basic Attack to trigger Unrestrained Words after the <NumGreen>3rd</> hit of Walk the Talk.<cf>Hold down the stick and hold Dodge to trigger Unrestrained Words during battle.<cf>Fires <NumGreen>3</> incantation commands vertically. After a brief delay, the commands detonate, with each dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area.
entries.cang_skilldes::ga_cang_melee4_des: Generates a Power Word <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangZhu">Bless</> on the enemy for every <NumGreen>3</> Walk the Talk hits. This word lasts for <NumGreen>15s</>, and a maximum of <NumGreen>3</> can be generated.<cf>Consumes <NumGreen>3%</> of Baicang's current HP whenever any Power Word is summoned. When Baicang's HP is below <NumGreen>50%</>, the amount consumed is halved.
entries.cang_skilldes::ga_cang_melee5_des: Leaps in the wind and strikes, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.
entries.cang_skilldes::ga_cang_melee6_des: Triggers when casting Walk the Talk after a Critical Dodge. Performs a knee strike on the target, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area, reducing their Break. Generates <NumGreen>1</> Power Word <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangZhu">Bless</> on the target when hit.
entries.cang_skilldes::ga_cang_melee_background: <Italic>Just some really basic moves. Day after day of training under family discipline since childhood, the young boy's arms have become strong and broad.</>
entries.cang_skilldes::ga_cang_passive_1_backgro: <Italic>Sigh… break time's over again. Now then, let's wrap this up quickly, shall we?</>
entries.cang_skilldes::ga_cang_passive_1_des: <TextHLT>Scorch Enhancement</>: Inflicts another instance of Scorch with the same effect as the existing one when a Power Word is generated on a target affected by Scorch.
entries.cang_skilldes::ga_cang_passive_2_backgro: <Italic>Sure, we're all a bunch of eccentric weirdos who do our own thing, but we have our moments of perfect teamwork too. Spend enough time together, and your body starts to remember each other's habits and movements. What was that just now? Why, that was ETD-4's passionate combo, of course!</>
entries.cang_skilldes::ga_cang_passive_2_des: Increases Baicang's ATK by <NumGreen>20%</>.<cf>Launches coordinate attacks with the allies when there are ETD-4 members in the Team.<cf>In combat, switching to Baicang while Skia is in stealth to immediately attack with Baicang and generate 1 Power Word <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangJin">Silence</> on target. Cooldown: <NumGreen>30s</>.<cf>In combat, when Fadia's HP drops below <NumGreen>20%</>, Baicang attacks the enemy <NumGreen>1</> time, heals Fadia <NumGreen>1</> time, and generates <NumGreen>1</> Power Word <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangJin">Silence</> on target. Cooldown: <NumGreen>30s</>.<cf>Switching to Baicang while Lacrimosa is in bat form can trigger <NumGreen>1</> super jump for Baicang.
entries.cang_skilldes::ga_cang_qte_des: Witness the power that words bestow. Charges briefly and writes incantation commands, targeting enemies and dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area. Generates <NumGreen>1</> Power Word <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangJin">Silence</> on target when attacks hit.
entries.cang_skilldes::ga_cang_skill_1_des: Press Redirect Skill after triggering a dodge.<cf>Attacks a single target, dealing <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to them on hit. Generates <NumGreen>1</> Power Word <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangJin">Silence</> on the target when attacks hit.
entries.cang_skilldes::ga_cang_skill_2_des: Press Redirect Skill after triggering Formless Words or Unrestrained Words.<cf>Expanded the damage range, dealing AoE <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> on hit. Generates <NumGreen>1</> Power Word <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangLi">Objurgate</> on the ground near the target when attacks hit.
entries.cang_skilldes::ga_cang_skill_3_des: Words and text emerge from the ley lines, converge at the target location, and unleash an attack.
entries.cang_skilldes::ga_cang_skill_background: <Italic>Every strike carries genuine intent. The voice once found, the home once briefly held, keeping memories of the departed close to heart. Smile! For now he has to power to protect.</>
entries.cang_skilldes::ga_cang_star1_des: Increases Baicang's next Skill's damage by <NumGreen>30%</> when Silence triggers during Judgment of Autumn. Effect stacks. Reduces Baicang's Skill cooldown by <NumGreen>4s</> when Objurgate triggers. Effect stacks (applies to the next use if no Skill is on cooldown).
entries.cang_skilldes::ga_cang_star2_des: Like those mountain ranges, layer upon layer. Every <NumGreen>1</> Power Word generated increases Baicang's ATK by <NumGreen>6%</>, up to <NumGreen>4</> stacks. Each stack lasts <NumGreen>10s</>.
entries.cang_skilldes::ga_cang_star3_des: Increases Power Word generation limit to <NumGreen>4</>.
entries.cang_skilldes::ga_cang_star4_des: Restores an additional <NumGreen>5%</> of Max HP when any <NumGreen>1</> Power Word triggers during Judgment of Autumn.
entries.cang_skilldes::ga_cang_star5_des: It's not over yet. Increases the duration of Judgment of Autumn to <NumGreen>16s</>.
entries.cang_skilldes::ga_cang_star6_des: Increases Baicang's CRIT Rate by <NumGreen>30%</> during Judgment of Autumn.
entries.cang_skilldes::ga_cang_starextra1_des: Increases the skill level of Walk the Talk, Generous Guidance, and Judgment of Autumn by <NumGreen>1</>.
entries.cang_skilldes::ga_cang_starextra2_des: Captain, sometimes. Grants all allies within the domain <NumGreen>20%</> ATK and the Execution effect during Judgment of Autumn.
entries.cang_skilldes::ga_cang_utraskill_backgro: <Italic>No one understands the power of words themselves better than Baicang. Until the very last moment, no one knows whether those waveforms taking shape in the air represent curses or blessings. Perhaps—only by glimpsing into the heart can one truly discern.</>
entries.cang_skilldes::ga_cang_utraskill_des: Look up, and fall into the polar abyss. Releases a domain and enters Power Word state, dealing <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> over time to targets.<cf>Executes the target when their HP is below <NumGreen>10%</> (Boss HP below <NumGreen>5%</>).<cf>Becomes immune to one fatal hit temporarily during Judgment of Autumn and records its value. Ends the domain automatically <NumGreen>3</>s after triggering the immunity effect and takes the recorded damage slowly over <NumGreen>10</>s after ending.<cf>Deals high single-target damage within the domain when <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangJin">Silence</> is triggered; Deals AoE DMG when <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangLi">Objurgate</> is triggered; Deals damage to a single target and restores <NumGreen>5%</> of Baicang's Max HP when <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&CangZhu">Bless</> is triggered.
entries.chaos_skilldes::ga_chaos_melee1_des: Wields his weapon and performs up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> and building up <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosGuilt">Crime</>.
entries.chaos_skilldes::ga_chaos_melee2_des: Your guilt is plain to see. Hold Basic Attack to trigger Final Verdict. Consumes all <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosGuilt">Crime</> to add a 2nd hit to Final Verdict and deal heavy Settlement DMG if current <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosGuilt">Crime</> is at its cap (1000). Performs only the 1st hit of Final Verdict, dealing <NumGreen>2</> instances of damage, if <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosGuilt">Crime</> has not reached its cap.
entries.chaos_skilldes::ga_chaos_melee3_des: Press Basic Attack while airborne to plunge, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to <NumGreen>1×</>. Focuses his mind and awakens a hunter's perception, sensing nearby enemies for a short time. Sensed targets are highlighted with a special outline.
entries.chaos_skilldes::ga_chaos_passive_1_backg: <Italic>Do you still believe every right answer leads to light? </>
entries.chaos_skilldes::ga_chaos_passive_1_des: <TextHLT>Remora Enhancement</>: Deals <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> equal to 800% of ATK to the target when Remora ends, based on Remora's duration. Each second beyond the base 5s duration increases total DMG by 45%, up to 300%. Resets Remora's duration when reapplied.
entries.chaos_skilldes::ga_chaos_passive_2_des: Increases the damage bonus from <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosHuntPermit">Warrant</> to <NumGreen>30%</>.
entries.chaos_skilldes::ga_chaos_passive_3_backg: <Italic>Yet the shadow of the past remains out of reach. </>
entries.chaos_skilldes::ga_chaos_passive_3_des: Hold Aim in the open world to leave his hound behind as a teleport anchor. When teleporting from the map, the hound tears open a doorway through space, allowing Chaos to return to the anchor’s location.
entries.chaos_skilldes::ga_chaos_perfectevade_de: Triggers when using Pursuit after performing a Critical Dodge. Swings his hatchet at the target, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> and reducing Break.
entries.chaos_skilldes::ga_chaos_qte_background: <Italic>United in purpose, through fair weather and foul, as they once were. </>
entries.chaos_skilldes::ga_chaos_qte_des: Don't even think about running! Swings his scythe upward, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</>.
entries.chaos_skilldes::ga_chaos_skill1_des: Target traits confirmed. Fires at enemies ahead and summons his hound to pounce on the target. The hound bites the target back and forth <NumGreen>twice</>. Inflicts <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosHuntPermit">Warrant</> on up to <NumGreen>2</> enemies for <NumGreen>15</>s when the skill hits. Increases damage dealt by <NumGreen>20%</> when attacking targets with <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosHuntPermit">Warrant</>.
entries.chaos_skilldes::ga_chaos_skill_backgroun: <Italic>Chaos can't remember when the hound first appeared. He only remembers missing the little dog from home, and then the hound was there. </>
entries.chaos_skilldes::ga_chaos_star1_des: Grants an additional <NumGreen>40%</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosGuilt">Crime</> when attacking enemies with <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosHuntPermit">Warrant</>.
entries.chaos_skilldes::ga_chaos_star2_des: Ignores <NumGreen>20%</> of the target's DEF when attacking enemies with <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosHuntPermit">Warrant</>.
entries.chaos_skilldes::ga_chaos_star3_des: Increases Crit DMG by <NumGreen>30%</> for <NumGreen>20</>s after casting Retribution. Resets the duration when triggered again.
entries.chaos_skilldes::ga_chaos_star4_des: Transfers <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosHuntPermit">Warrant</> to a nearby unmarked target and recalculates its duration when defeating a target with <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosHuntPermit">Warrant</>.
entries.chaos_skilldes::ga_chaos_star5_des: Increases damage dealt to the target by <NumGreen>20%</> when only <NumGreen>1</> target with <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosHuntPermit">Warrant</> remains on the field.
entries.chaos_skilldes::ga_chaos_star6_des: Immediately restores <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosGuilt">Crime</> to its cap after casting Retribution.
entries.chaos_skilldes::ga_chaos_starextra1_des: Increases the skill level of Pursuit, Doubtmark, and Retribution by <NumGreen>1</>.
entries.chaos_skilldes::ga_chaos_starextra2_des: Reduces the <Xiang>Lakshana Resistance</> of enemies with <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosHuntPermit">Warrant</> by <NumGreen>10%</>.
entries.chaos_skilldes::ga_chaos_ultraskill_back: <Italic>Deep down, you know good and evil cycle endlessly, and none of it ever truly ends. </>
entries.chaos_skilldes::ga_chaos_ultraskill_des: Summons his hound to suppress nearby enemies, inflicting <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosHuntPermit">Warrant</> on all enemies within range and entering the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosInfamyCycle">Dread Echo</> state. Rapidly increases <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChaosGuilt">Crime</> over time while Chaos and Dread Echo are active, allowing Final Verdict to be cast more often and deal heavy Settlement DMG.
entries.chiichan_skilldes::ga_chiichan_melee1_de: Swings the short staff to perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>. Grants <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes1">Grain</> on hit.
entries.chiichan_skilldes::ga_chiichan_melee2_de: Press Blighted Vale to throw Brown Sugar Boba to devour the target, dealing 2 instance of Cosmos DMG, granting a certain amount of Grain and Fons. Triggers up to once every 2.5s.<cf>Hold Blighted Vale during any instance of Exiled Swordplay attacks to create a branch attack, dealing 2 instance of Cosmos DMG and granting a certain amount of Grain and Fons.<cf>Grants bonus Fons if this skill defeats the target.<cf>Up to 250,000 Fons can be earned this way. Increasing the Tycoon Level to 25 raises the cap to 500,000 Fons. Grants 1 Fons per use once the daily cap is reached. After reaching the total limit, no more Fons can be obtained this way.
entries.chiichan_skilldes::ga_chiichan_melee3_de: Press Basic Attack while airborne to plunge, dealing 1 instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to an area upon impact, while granting a certain amount of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes1">Grain</>. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.
entries.chiichan_skilldes::ga_chiichan_melee_bac: <Italic>Jade for good times, grain for lean times.</>
entries.chiichan_skilldes::ga_chiichan_passive1_: <Italic>Longing… it's a white bird rising from a wound. If only you could see.</>
<TextHLT>Charge Enhancement</>: Grants active characters 4 additional Ultimate Energy.
entries.chiichan_skilldes::ga_chiichan_passive2_: <Italic>The past is a bottomless ravine. No matter how many stones you throw, not a single echo ever returns.</>
Increases Chiz's Charge Efficiency by 20% while on the field.
entries.chiichan_skilldes::ga_chiichan_perfectev: Triggers when pressing Basic Attack after a Critical Dodge. Leaps to evade and swings the staff, sending Brown Sugar Boba crashing into the target, dealing 1 instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>, reducing Break, and granting <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes1">Grain</>.
entries.chiichan_skilldes::ga_chiichan_qte_des: Hope I can m-make it in time…<cf>Brown Sugar Boba carries Chiz and crashes into the target, dealing 1 instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>.
entries.chiichan_skilldes::ga_chiichan_skill_bac: <Italic>Frontispiece of the Pink Paws Bank Employee Handbook: In tribute to the great Lord Ladon.</>
entries.chiichan_skilldes::ga_chiichan_skill_des: The more, the merrier; the more, the better. Stacks Redirect Skill attempts, up to 3 stacks<cf><cf>Press Redirect Skill to consume 1 stack and cast No Grain, dealing Cosmos DMG once. Press Redirect Skill consecutively to consume stacks and cast No Grain, Half Grain, and Full Grain in order, up to 3 times in a row.<cf>Press to cast Pink Paws Priority Principle while in the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes2">Surplus</> state, dealing bonus <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> based on available <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes1">Grains</> using Redirect Skills. Cannot Crit.<cf><cf>Hold Redirect Skill to consume 2 stacks and cast No Grain and Half Grain. Continuously consumes <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes1">Grains</> while Half Grain is active, dealing consecutive bonus <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> based on available Grains. Cannot Crit. Consumes all available Grains (including all <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes4">Grain Loans</> from the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes3">Debt</> state) when Half Grain ends. Press Redirect Skill again to consume 1 stack and end Half Grain early, allowing Full Grain to be cast without consuming Grains. Hold Redirect Skill to consume 3 stacks and use all available Grains (including all Grain Loans from the Debt state). Casts No Grain, Half Grain, and Full Grain in order.<cf>Hold to cast Pink Paws Priority Principle while Surplus is active, dealing bonus <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> with No Grain based on remaining Grains. Cannot Crit.
entries.chiichan_skilldes::ga_chiichan_star1_des: Increases the storage capacity of Grain and Grain Loan by 10%.
entries.chiichan_skilldes::ga_chiichan_star2_des: Grants 10% of current Grain as interest per second while Chiz is in the Surplus state.
entries.chiichan_skilldes::ga_chiichan_star3_des: Increases the chance of a Grain Price increase by 50%.
entries.chiichan_skilldes::ga_chiichan_star3_nam: If There Were No Rainy Days
entries.chiichan_skilldes::ga_chiichan_star5_des: Grants Chiz Grain equal to 100% of the Grain storage limit upon entering combat.
entries.chiichan_skilldes::ga_chiichan_star6_des: Increases the Bonus Cosmos DMG of Grain by 15%.
entries.chiichan_skilldes::ga_chiichan_starextra: Increases Grain acquisition efficiency by an extra 50% while in the Debt state.
Reduces the target's Cosmos Resistance by 10% upon Chiz dealing damage.
entries.chiichan_skilldes::ga_chiichan_ultraskil: <Italic>I will be the only one to win this battle.</>

No turning back, max the leverage. Throws Brown Sugar Boba to strike, dealing AoE <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> once and entering Grain Market for 7s. During this time, the first Grain Settlement DMG is guaranteed to Crit.<cf>Converts all remaining <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes4">Grain Loans</> into <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes1">Grains</> and enters the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes2">Surplus</> state after casting Zero-Sum Game. Invests all Grains into the Grain Market. Afterward, press Pink Paws Priority Principle to gain Grains based on current <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes5">Grain Price</> fluctuations during <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes6">Grain Settlement</>. Hold Pink Paws Priority Principle to trigger Grain Settlement once based on the Grain Price on first activation.<cf>Leaves the Grain Market and prioritizes repaying Grain Loans with all available Grains when Grain Market duration ends.<cf>Grants access to the Grain Market while in <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes3">Debt</> state and holding any Grain Loans.
entries.daffodill_skilldes::ga_daffodill_melee1_: Her heart is as calm as still waters, long accustomed to battle. Wields her twin blades to perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <An>Chaos DMG</>.
entries.daffodill_skilldes::ga_daffodill_melee2_: Light and shadow exist in separate realms. Daffodill's Break Damage contribution is increased by 20%.
entries.daffodill_skilldes::ga_daffodill_melee3_: I am here. Hold Basic Attack to trigger. Dashes forward, performing a whirlwind slash and leaving behind marks, dealing <An>Chaos DMG</>.
entries.daffodill_skilldes::ga_daffodill_melee4_: Press dodge to trigger the special dodge action Displaced Edge during Still Waters. Grants invincibility during the action and does not interrupt the current combo.
entries.daffodill_skilldes::ga_daffodill_melee5_: Wields her weapon while airborne and plunges, dealing 1 instance of <An>Chaos DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.
entries.daffodill_skilldes::ga_daffodill_passive: <Italic>Beneath her expressionless façade, fleeting moments of tenderness may appear, like sunlight dancing on snow.</>

<TextHLT>Discord Enhancement</>: Further reduces the target's Break cap by 10% for 30s while affected by Discord and restores it to normal upon leaving combat. Stacks Discord Enhancement effects up to a maximum reduction of 20% of the target's initial Break cap.
<Italic>She once wandered the gray borderlands like a machine, but now she has somewhere to call home.</>
Increases <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&DaffodillQTE">Phantom Step</> DMG by 80%.
entries.daffodill_skilldes::ga_daffodill_perfect: Triggers when using Still Waters after performing a Critical Dodge. Instantly lifts her foot, pulling the rope to swing her blade toward the target, dealing 1 instance of <An>Chaos DMG</> and reducing Break.
entries.daffodill_skilldes::ga_daffodill_qte_bac: <Italic>The bodyguard at Eibon Antique Shop has always been reliable. Her clean, efficient skills inspire confidence that, as long as she‘s trusted, any problem can be solved with ease.</>
entries.daffodill_skilldes::ga_daffodill_qte_des: Leave the rest to me. Swings her blade in a slashing motion, dealing 1 instance of <An>Chaos DMG</> to the target.
entries.daffodill_skilldes::ga_daffodill_skill1_: Resonating with the blade. Deals damage to the target. Grants Resonance stacks and increases damage when any team member casts a Support Skill. Increases Resonance's DMG and Break per Support Skill cast, up to 2 stacks. Enhances Resonance and replaces it with Echoes when stacks reach the maximum.
entries.daffodill_skilldes::ga_daffodill_skill2_: Resonance carries sound, echo responds in kind. Swiftly shifts her stance, swinging her blade with the rope to deal <An>Chaos DMG</> to the target.
entries.daffodill_skilldes::ga_daffodill_skill_b: <Italic>A girl trapped in a beautiful garden was no more than a prisoner in a cave. Only after gaining kaleidoscope eyes that could see through all things did she feel her way along the walls and stumble into a new world.</>
entries.daffodill_skilldes::ga_daffodill_star1_d: Increases allies' Resonance's DMG by <NumGreen>100%</> and Break by <NumGreen>250%</> per Support Skill cast.
entries.daffodill_skilldes::ga_daffodill_star2_d: Deals high damage to the target, generates Break, and fully charges Finale with the final attack if <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&DaffodillQTE">Phantom Step</> fails to Parry Attack the target.
entries.daffodill_skilldes::ga_daffodill_star3_d: Prevents <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&DaffodillInsight">Insight</> from being removed once applied, except when the target is neutralized or leaves combat. Allows repeated applications to stack, up to <NumGreen>2</> stacks.
entries.daffodill_skilldes::ga_daffodill_star4_d: Increases Break DMG by <NumGreen>15%</> for each stack of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&DaffodillInsight">Insight</> when a target enters Break while under the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&DaffodillInsight">Insight</> effect.
entries.daffodill_skilldes::ga_daffodill_star5_d: Deals <NumGreen>1</> additional instance of Break Damage per stack of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&DaffodillInsight">Insight</> if the target enters Break while affected by <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&DaffodillInsight">Insight</>.
entries.daffodill_skilldes::ga_daffodill_star6_d: Ignores <NumGreen>15%</> of the target's DEF when dealing damage.
entries.daffodill_skilldes::ga_daffodill_starext: Increases the skill level of Still Waters, Resonance, and Witness This Finale by 1.
Reduces a target's Chaos Resistance by <NumGreen>15%</> when they enter Break.
entries.daffodill_skilldes::ga_daffodill_utraski: <Italic>"I have lost everything. What exactly am I supposed to toast to?"</><cf><Italic>"Do you need a reason to toast? Well… then let's toast to absolute despair, to skies we've never seen, and to the one and only narcissus blooming in the heart of this lake."</>

Casts Finale, dealing <An>Chaos DMG</> to enemies in an area. Unseals her left eye, increasing damage and inflicting <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&DaffodillInsight">Insight</> on nearby enemies for the duration. Unlocks the skill <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&DaffodillQTE">Phantom Step</>, which can be used up to 2 times. Casting Finale resets Phantom Step charges.
entries.edgar_skilldes::ga_edgar_melee1_des: Applies what he learned in Lamplight Academy's physical education class to perform up to 5 consecutive attacks that deal <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>.
entries.edgar_skilldes::ga_edgar_melee2_des: Press Basic Attack while airborne to plunge, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.
entries.edgar_skilldes::ga_edgar_melee3_des: Triggers when using Combat Practice after a Critical Dodge.<cf>Charges toward the target and uses his backpack to unleash a Flow attack, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to an area and reducing Break.
entries.edgar_skilldes::ga_edgar_melee_backgroun: <Italic>Edgar believes there must be a more humane way to contain them. Until that solution is found, he is forced to rely on rougher methods.</>
entries.edgar_skilldes::ga_edgar_passive_1_backg: <Italic>Like many geniuses, Edgar carries a quiet pride. Unlike most, his brilliance is gentle and understated, guiding him through every challenge he has faced.</>
entries.edgar_skilldes::ga_edgar_passive_1_des: <TextHLT>Charge Enhancement</>: Grants 120 Ultimate Energy instantly when a character triggers Charge using a Support Skill. Disables Ultimate Energy gain from Vita Pistils when hitting Slowed targets afterward. Cooldown: 30s.
entries.edgar_skilldes::ga_edgar_passive_2_backg: <Italic>Whenever Edgar sees the warm lights of Eibon, comfort rises in his heart. In an ever-changing world, this warmth remains a constant.</>
entries.edgar_skilldes::ga_edgar_passive_2_des: Cast Redirect Skill Wild Current or Support Skill Weight of Knowledge to gain a Key of Truth, up to 3 keys.<cf>Each Key of Truth extends the duration of Ultimate: Finnegan's Vigil by 1s.
entries.edgar_skilldes::ga_edgar_qte_des: This bag is really heavy. Edgar charges toward the target and swings his bag with all his might, dealing 1 instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to an area.
entries.edgar_skilldes::ga_edgar_skill_backgroun: <Italic>Healing is important work. Edgar realized that the rules he learned from games apply in real life as well.</>
entries.edgar_skilldes::ga_edgar_skill_des: Hold to enter a channeling state, continuously casting Current at the target, dealing <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> and continuously healing the teammate with the lowest HP.<cf>The CD of Redirect Skill: Wild Current increases based on the duration of use.
entries.edgar_skilldes::ga_edgar_star1_des: Grants Edgar 1 <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&EdgarKey">Key of Truth</> whenever any teammate casts a Support Skill.
entries.edgar_skilldes::ga_edgar_star2_des: Caps the max cooldown extension from Wild Current at <NumGreen>3</>s.
entries.edgar_skilldes::ga_edgar_star3_des: Increases Wild Current's healing effectiveness for allies with current HP below <NumGreen>30%</> by <NumGreen>15%</>.
entries.edgar_skilldes::ga_edgar_star5_name: Guardian of the Antique Shop's Light
entries.edgar_skilldes::ga_edgar_star6_des: Grants <NumGreen>15%</> DEF to all allies in the range of Finnegan's Wake.
entries.edgar_skilldes::ga_edgar_starextra1_des: Increases the skill level of Wild Current, Finnegan's Wake, and Weight of Knowledge by <NumGreen>1</>.
entries.edgar_skilldes::ga_edgar_starextra2_des: Edgar's thoughts are stirred by his allies' safety. Converts <NumGreen>3%</> of any teammate's Max HP lost into <NumGreen>1</> Charge for Finnegan's Vigil, up to <NumGreen>20</> Charges. Resets after casting Finnegan's Vigil.
entries.edgar_skilldes::ga_edgar_ultraskill_back: <Italic>Always curious, always questioning. Edgar often slips into deep thought without warning. Pulling him out of his complex musings is no easy task.</>
entries.edgar_skilldes::ga_edgar_ultraskill_des: Immerses in his own thoughts, unleashing a labyrinthine domain for 10s. Deals 1 instance of AoE <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>. Heals the current character over the domain's duration.
entries.fadia_skilldes::ga_fadia_melee1_des: Swings her cross shield and performs up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <Hun>Psyche DMG</>.
entries.fadia_skilldes::ga_fadia_melee2_des: When Fadia's current HP is greater than <NumGreen>1</>, she redirects a portion of damage taken by her teammates to herself before any shield mitigation is applied. Redirected damage cannot be further redistributed.<cf>Once Fadia's current HP drops to <NumGreen>1</>, she ceases to redirect damage. At this point, if Fadia receives damage, she will share it with surviving teammates before any shield mitigation, and will absorb the remaining damage herself.
entries.fadia_skilldes::ga_fadia_melee3_des: Swings her cross shield in the air and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.
entries.fadia_skilldes::ga_fadia_melee_backgroun: <Italic>The most laughable thing about being alive is how you bow to self-evident meanings and submit to the power of orders. So why not laugh at you pitiful worms?</>
entries.fadia_skilldes::ga_fadia_passive_1_backg: <Italic>More… MORE! Fill this void—if you can!</>
entries.fadia_skilldes::ga_fadia_passive_1_des: <TextHLT>Nova Enhancement</>: Allows all allies to drain Max HP from the target when Nova ends. The target loses Max HP equal to 200% of Fadia's base Max HP, and each ally gains Max HP equal to 10% of Fadia's base Max HP. Total drained cannot exceed 50% of Fadia's base Max HP. Restores both parties' stats upon exiting combat.
entries.fadia_skilldes::ga_fadia_passive_2_backg: <Italic>If you want it, go grab it.</>
entries.fadia_skilldes::ga_fadia_passive_2_des: Like a baby yearning for nourishment from mommy. When Fadia is in the team, increases team max HP by <NumGreen>10%</>.
entries.fadia_skilldes::ga_fadia_passive_3_backg: <Italic>When Skia and Lacrimosa passed by Tamamochi Street after a mission, Lacrimosa went into a 2-Four Convenience Store. She thought she'd walk out with arms full of free tomato jelly packets, just like how Fadia always gets showered with gifts…</><cf><Italic>In the end, all she got was a reward that Skia bought right there and then.</>
entries.fadia_skilldes::ga_fadia_passive_3_des: Allows Fadia to receive special gifts from shopkeepers who take a liking to her while exploring the city.
entries.fadia_skilldes::ga_fadia_perfectevade_de: Triggers when casting Wordless Rejection after a Critical Dodge. Charges toward the target at high speed and deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to an area, reducing Break.
entries.fadia_skilldes::ga_fadia_qte_des: Swings her cross shield, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to an area.
entries.fadia_skilldes::ga_fadia_skill_backgroun: <Italic>"Oh hey—just a friendly tip from her teammate: attacking her right now might not be the smartest move…"</>
entries.fadia_skilldes::ga_fadia_skill_des: Come, have a taste of this. Deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to an area and inflicts <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaSkill">Destructive Experience</> on the enemy with the highest Max HP in the area for a period.<cf>During the duration, when Fadia takes damage, the target shares a percentage of the damage taken.<cf><hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaSkill">Destructive Experience</> ends when the duration expires, when the Redirection DMG taken by the target reaches its cap, or when the target and Fadia leave combat.
entries.fadia_skilldes::ga_fadia_star1_des: Fadia's damage redirect ratio is increased to <NumGreen>75%</>.
entries.fadia_skilldes::ga_fadia_star2_des: Increases the damage ratio enemies take through <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaSkill">Destructive Experience</> to <NumGreen>600%</> and raises its damage cap to <NumGreen>25%</> of Fadia’s Max HP. Deals immediate damage equal to the difference between the damage already taken and the damage cap when <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaSkill">Destructive Experience</> is removed.
entries.fadia_skilldes::ga_fadia_star3_des: Upon entering combat, Fadia increases her base Max HP by <NumGreen>30%</>. After leaving combat, she loses the increased Max HP.
entries.fadia_skilldes::ga_fadia_star4_des: Increases Fadia's healing ratio to <NumGreen>30%</> of Max HP while in <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaState">Lilith</> form. Further increases the healing ratio to <NumGreen>60%</> of Max HP when her lost HP is greater than or equal to the <TextHLT>Destructive Threshold</>.
entries.fadia_skilldes::ga_fadia_star5_des: Increases Fadia's CRIT Rate by <NumGreen>50%</> while in Lilith state.
entries.fadia_skilldes::ga_fadia_star6_des: Inflicts <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaSkill">Destructive Experience</> on up to <NumGreen>10</> targets within range. Each <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaSkill">Destructive Experience</>'s duration and damage cap are calculated individually.
entries.fadia_skilldes::ga_fadia_starextra1_des: Increases the skill level of Wordless Rejection, Existence, and Agony to Euphoria by <NumGreen>1</>.
entries.fadia_skilldes::ga_fadia_starextra2_des: Grants all team members 10% ATK while Fadia is on the team.
entries.fadia_skilldes::ga_fadia_ultraskill_back: <Italic>"Since the Director chose to exploit this instability, my duty is to observe and restrict it—to ensure such dangerous volatility stays within controllable bounds."</>
entries.fadia_skilldes::ga_fadia_utraskill_des: Without pain, life closes in on itself. Enters <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaState">Lilith</> state, dealing <NumGreen>6</> instances of Mental DMG and restoring HP. Recasts Wordless Rejection while in <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaState">Lilith</> state to perform up to <NumGreen>5</> follow-up attacks, each dealing Mental DMG.<cf>Fully restores the energy of Agony to Euphoria when lost HP reaches the <TextHLT>Destructive Threshold</>. Increases the damage and HP restored by Agony to Euphoria when it is cast with lost HP greater than or equal to the <TextHLT>Destructive Threshold</>.<cf>Exits <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&FadiaState">Lilith</> state when the duration ends, all 5 follow-up attacks are performed, characters are switched, or other skills of Fadia are used.
entries.female051_skilldes::ga_f_melee1_des: Channels energy through the weapon, performing up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks that deal <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>.
entries.female051_skilldes::ga_f_melee2_des: Wields the weapon mid-air and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.
entries.female051_skilldes::ga_f_qte_des: Slashes through space and detonates a rift, dealing <NumGreen>2</> instances of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to an area.
entries.female051_skilldes::ga_f_starextra2_des: Grants the team <NumGreen>12%</> ATK for <NumGreen>20s</> when Zero triggers any Cosmos Esper Cycle.
entries.female051_skilldes::ga_female051_perfect: Triggers when using Appraisal - Severance after a Critical Dodge. Seizes the opening from the enemy's missed attack and swings the weapon to counter, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to an area and reducing Break.
entries.female051_skilldes::ga_female_melee_back: <Italic>Handling a sword is the only way I feel in control.</>
entries.female051_skilldes::ga_female_passive_1_: <Italic>Where will this ability to read and understand anomalies lead me?</>
<TextHLT>Charge Enhancement</>: Restores HP equal to 50% of Zero's Base ATK when the active character gains Ultimate Energy.
entries.female051_skilldes::ga_female_passive_2_: Ultimate: Divide by Zero damage increases by <NumGreen>25%</>.
entries.female051_skilldes::ga_female_skill_back: <Italic>A surreal scene, outlined in slashes, emerges from thin air.</>
entries.female051_skilldes::ga_female_skill_des: Opening, exposed! Performs <NumGreen>3</> consecutive weapon strikes. Leaps into the air to charge. Fires an Esper Cannon that deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to an area. Deals an additional <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to the first enemy hit whose level is below Zero's own level.
entries.female051_skilldes::ga_female_star1_des: Deals <NumGreen>1</> additional hit of <NumGreen>200%</> ATK to enemies of lower level on first hit. This damage ignores <NumGreen>75%</> of the target's DEF.
entries.female051_skilldes::ga_female_star2_des: Grants an additional <NumGreen>8</> Ultimate Energy after successfully casting Appraise and Engrave.
entries.female051_skilldes::ga_female_star3_des: Increases Divide by Zero's Crit Chance by <NumGreen>50%</>.
entries.female051_skilldes::ga_female_star4_des: Every <NumGreen>1</> point of Zero's Base ATK increases Ultimate: Divide by Zero damage by <NumGreen>0.1%</>, up to a maximum of <NumGreen>25%</>.
entries.female051_skilldes::ga_female_star5_des: Increases Zero's ATK by <NumGreen>10%</> for <NumGreen>20s</> when triggering Support Skill.
entries.female051_skilldes::ga_female_star6_des: Increases Extra DMG Ratio of Appraise and Engrave to <NumGreen>300%</> of ATK.
entries.female051_skilldes::ga_female_utraskill_: <Italic>I sense an Anomaly Nexus, bound by invisible, silent, intangible ties… All severed in an instant with a single graceful strike.</>
Sweeps away the unseen lines that connect the Nexus in a dance of blades. Deals multiple instances of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to an area.
entries.female_skilldes::ga_f_starextra1_des: Increases the skill level of Appraisal, Appraise and Engrave, and Divide by Zero by <NumGreen>1</>.
entries.haniel_skilldes::ga_haniel_melee1_des: Fires magic projectiles and performs up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <Hun>Psyche DMG</>.
entries.haniel_skilldes::ga_haniel_melee2_des: Hold Basic Attack during the 1st hit to charge, then fire <NumGreen>a</> charged cannon forward.
entries.haniel_skilldes::ga_haniel_melee3_des: Press Basic Attack while airborne to plunge, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.
entries.haniel_skilldes::ga_haniel_melee_backgro: <Italic>The difference between magic tricks and real magic? As long as you believe, it exists… Like conjuring orbs with your bare hands?</>
entries.haniel_skilldes::ga_haniel_passive_1_bac: <Italic>For Haniel, she'd rather hear lively stories about companions than lonely tales of heroism. Even a bunch of hot-headed fools would be fine.</>
entries.haniel_skilldes::ga_haniel_passive_1_des: <TextHLT>Nova Enhancement</>: Allows all allies to drain ATK from the target when Nova ends. The target loses ATK equal to 4% of Haniel's Base ATK, and each ally gains ATK equal to 8% of Haniel's Base ATK. The total drain is capped at 16% of Haniel's Base ATK, and the target cannot lose more than 20% of their initial ATK. Restores both parties' stats upon exiting combat.
entries.haniel_skilldes::ga_haniel_passive_2_bac: <Italic>Sports anime makes you want to play sports. Band anime makes you want to learn an instrument. Battle anime… well, I wouldn't recommend trying that.</>
entries.haniel_skilldes::ga_haniel_passive_2_des: Grants Haniel <NumGreen>1</> stack of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielPassive2">Plot Armor</> when the current character triggers <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielUltraSkill">Ensemble</>, increasing the ricochet cap of Paranormal Cannon. Grants <NumGreen>1</> stack of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielPassive2">Plot Armor</> <NumGreen>per</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielUltraSkill">Ensemble</> trigger.<cf>Grants <NumGreen>2</> stacks of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielPassive2">Plot Armor</> <NumGreen>per</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielUltraSkill">Ensemble</> trigger while Haniel is in Paranormal Ace state.<cf>Can accumulate up to <NumGreen>4</> stacks of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielPassive2">Plot Armor</>.
entries.haniel_skilldes::ga_haniel_perfectevade_: Triggers when using Genesse Technique after a Critical Dodge. Being this slow will get us customer complaints, you know? Dodges the attack and fires a missile, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Hun>Psyche DMG</>, and reducing Break.
entries.haniel_skilldes::ga_haniel_qte_des: Don't be so boring! How about a little easter egg? Fires <NumGreen>1</> magic projectile at the enemy, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Hun>Psyche DMG</>.
entries.haniel_skilldes::ga_haniel_skill_backgro: <Italic>O owl of the quiet, moonlit forest depths, I, Haniel, hereby forge a contract with you! …Come on, Hootie, work with me here.</>
entries.haniel_skilldes::ga_haniel_skill_des: "O owl of the quiet, moonlit forest depths, answer my call!" Throws her portable speaker Hootie, dealing <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to an area.<cf>Grants the Team an ATK bonus based on Haniel's Base ATK while Hootie is active.<cf>Grants Hootie <NumGreen>1</> stack of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielSkill">Four-Part Harmony</> when the current character attacks, up to <NumGreen>1</> stack every <NumGreen>0.5s</>. Accumulating <NumGreen>4</> stacks of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielSkill">Four-Part Harmony</> triggers <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielUltraSkill">Ensemble</>, dealing <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to enemies in an area around Hootie.<cf>Only <NumGreen>1</> Hootie can exist at a time. Casting again refreshes Hootie's duration. Hootie remains when switching characters.
entries.haniel_skilldes::ga_haniel_star1_des: Increases Plot Armor's max stacks to <NumGreen>6</> and raises Paranormal Cannon's ricochet limit to <NumGreen>6</>.
entries.haniel_skilldes::ga_haniel_star1_name: New here! Genius transfer student reporting in!
entries.haniel_skilldes::ga_haniel_star2_name: Legendary! The g'old back row window seat!
entries.haniel_skilldes::ga_haniel_star3_des: Increases Haniel's Crit Chance by <NumGreen>20%</> while in Paranormal Ace state.
entries.haniel_skilldes::ga_haniel_star3_name: Assemble! The hero team is formed!
entries.haniel_skilldes::ga_haniel_star4_des: While in Paranormal Ace state, if Haniel triggers <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielUltraSkill">Ensemble</>, her next attack's additional DMG increases by <NumGreen>100%</>.
entries.haniel_skilldes::ga_haniel_star5_des: Increases Haniel's <Hun>Psyche DMG</> by <NumGreen>30%</> while in Paranormal Ace state.
entries.haniel_skilldes::ga_haniel_starextra1_de: Increases the skill level of Genesse Technique, Silent Moonlit Forest Guardian, and A Melody Named Haniel by <NumGreen>1</>.
entries.haniel_skilldes::ga_haniel_starextra2_de: Increases the team's Crit DMG by <NumGreen>12%</> while in the Paranormal Ace state.
entries.haniel_skilldes::ga_haniel_ultraskill_ba: <Italic>You won't find Genesse Girls' Academy on any map of Hethereau, and naturally you won't find the Paranormal Department either. This story begins with Haniel's first serialized novel…</>
entries.haniel_skilldes::ga_haniel_ultraskill_de: Genesse Girls' Academy Paranormal Department! Assuming control! Releases an enhancement field centered on herself and gaining the Paranormal Ace effect for a period of time.<cf>Grants the Team an ATK bonus based on Haniel's Base ATK.<cf>Triggering <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielUltraSkill">Ensemble</> simultaneously triggers 1 additional Ensemble - Symphony effect around the character with increased DMG and range. Ensemble - Symphony does not grant <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielPassive2">Plot Armor</> for Haniel. When triggering <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HanielUltraSkill">Ensemble</>, the current active character's next attack deals additional damage for <NumGreen>3s</>. Effect does not stack.<cf>While Paranormal Ace is active, Hootie's duration timer is paused until the end of the effect.
entries.hathor_skilldes::ga_hathor_melee1_des: Displays superior martial arts, performing up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</>.
entries.hathor_skilldes::ga_hathor_melee2_des: Plunges from the air, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.
entries.hathor_skilldes::ga_hathor_melee3_des: Hold Basic Attack to trigger. Sweeps around the target at high speed to knock them up, then restrains and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area on impact. Performs Final Dispatch if the target cannot be knocked up.
entries.hathor_skilldes::ga_hathor_melee_backgro: <Italic>Legend speaks of a secret art mastered only by Elite Couriers who have completed tens of thousands of flawless deliveries. With an almost instinctive striking rhythm, they tear through any obstacle blocking the delivery route, all to ensure a single successful delivery without breaking promises or trust.</>
entries.hathor_skilldes::ga_hathor_passive_1_bac: <Italic>Can't risk the delay. I'll handle it.</>
entries.hathor_skilldes::ga_hathor_passive_1_des: <TextHLT>Remora Enhancement</>: Extends the target's Remora duration to 12s and increases Crit Rate by 10% when allies attacking a target affected by Remora.
entries.hathor_skilldes::ga_hathor_passive_2_des: Grants <NumGreen>1</> stack of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</> after defeating a target.
entries.hathor_skilldes::ga_hathor_passive_3_bac: Deal with the risks in the process, so the results can be perfect.
entries.hathor_skilldes::ga_hathor_passive_3_des: Triggers <TextHLT>Excellent Rating Lock</> when Hathor is in the team and enemies remain nearby for more than <NumGreen>5s</>.<cf><TextHLT>Excellent Rating Lock</>: Lasts <NumGreen>5s</> after activation. If a target under this status attacks your team during this duration, <TextHLT>Excellent Rating Lock</> is removed, and Hathor gains <NumGreen>1</> stack of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</> (up to <NumGreen>6</> stacks).
entries.hathor_skilldes::ga_hathor_perfectevade_: Triggers when using Rapid Delivery after a Critical Dodge. Launches a lightning-fast counterattack, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area, reducing Break, and gaining <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</> on hit (up to <NumGreen>1</> stack every <NumGreen>5s</>).
entries.hathor_skilldes::ga_hathor_qte_des: The time has come. Strikes from the air, kicking the target to trigger an impact, dealing <NumGreen>2</> instances of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area.
entries.hathor_skilldes::ga_hathor_skill1_des: Target locked, time to wrap this up quickly. Leaps into the air and slashes the target in front with wings, gaining <NumGreen>2</> stacks of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</>.<cf>Hold to enter charge status, increasing the power of Aerial Command and inflicting targets in range with <TextEXPL>Five-Star Tracking</> effect. The charge lasts up to 5s, during which Hathor constantly deals AoE <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> while the skill range gradually expands. The effect ends when the skill button is released, concluding the charging phase.<cf><TextHLT>Five-Star Tracking</><cf>Lasts for 5s. Grants 3 stacks of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</> when the target attacks or hits Hathor or an ally during this time.
entries.hathor_skilldes::ga_hathor_skill2_des: Consumes <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</> to cast this skill while in <TextEXPL>Emergency Delivery</> status. Summons a motorcycle of thorns and unleashes a rapid combo on the target. Increases DEF while the skill is active.
entries.hathor_skilldes::ga_hathor_skill_backgro: <Italic>To ensure delivery within the time limit, forcibly eliminating enemies along the way is also one of the basic principles of the job.</>
entries.hathor_skilldes::ga_hathor_star1_des: Holding the Redirect Skill button for the first time in battle grants <NumGreen>6</> stacks of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</>.
entries.hathor_skilldes::ga_hathor_star2_des: Grants Hathor <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</> when <TextEXPL>Excellent Rating Lock</> and <TextEXPL>Five-Star Tracking</> naturally expire.
entries.hathor_skilldes::ga_hathor_star3_des: Hathor deals <NumGreen>15%</> increased damage to non-Boss targets.
entries.hathor_skilldes::ga_hathor_star4_des: Increases the Crit Chance of the next Cyclone Strike by <NumGreen>25%</> each time Cyclone Strike is successfully cast while in <TextEXPL>Emergency Delivery</> state. This effect is cleared when the current <TextEXPL>Emergency Delivery</> state ends.
entries.hathor_skilldes::ga_hathor_star5_des: Increases damage against targets by <NumGreen>1%</> for <NumGreen>every</> stack of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</> gained. This effect stacks up to <NumGreen>15%</> and is removed upon leaving combat.
entries.hathor_skilldes::ga_hathor_star6_des: Increases Crit DMG by <TextEXPL>30%</> while in <NumGreen>Emergency Delivery</> state.
entries.hathor_skilldes::ga_hathor_starextra1_de: Increases the skill level of Rapid Delivery, Aerial Command, and Rider Express by 1.
entries.hathor_skilldes::ga_hathor_starextra2_de: Ignores <NumGreen>10%</> of the target’s DEF while in <TextEXPL>Emergency Delivery</> state.
entries.hathor_skilldes::ga_hathor_ultraskill_de: Get out of the way. Summons a motorcycle made of thorns and circles around targets, charging at enemies ahead with increased speed. Launches into the air and dive-bombs the ground, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area.<cf>Enters <TextHLT>Emergency Delivery</> state for a period after skill activation and stops gaining <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</>. Upgrades Aerial Command to Cyclone Strike in this state. Increases Movement Speed and grants ATK bonus based on <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&HathorAnger">Express Delivery Power</> stacks. Ends <TextHLT>Emergency Delivery</> state immediately when switching characters during this period.
entries.jin_skilldes::ga_jin_melee1_des: Wields her weapon and performs up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>.
entries.jin_skilldes::ga_jin_melee2_des: Displays a <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&JinTime">Non-Closed Timepiece</> when Hotori is switched in. Rotates its pointer slowly clockwise over time, accumulating energy. Caps the energy the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&JinTime">Non-Closed Timepiece</> can accumulate at 120.
entries.jin_skilldes::ga_jin_melee3_des: Wields the weapon mid-air and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.
entries.jin_skilldes::ga_jin_melee4_des: Hold Basic Attack in combat to trigger. Gracefully dashes forward and attacks, dealing <NumGreen>4</> instances of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to an area.
entries.jin_skilldes::ga_jin_melee5_des: Let the snow fall slower still. Activates time manipulation when Hotori is outside of battle and the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&JinTime">Non-Closed Timepiece</> has accumulated energy greater than <NumGreen>0</>. Slows the flow of time while holding Basic Attack, causing the surrounding time to approach a standstill. Removes any received time control debuffs and grants immunity to time control debuffs during Time Stop.<cf>Rewinds the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&JinTime">Non-Closed Timepiece</> pointer continuously during Time Stop. Prevents Hotori from using other time-affecting skills. Ends Time Stop when the pointer fully rewinds, holding Basic Attack, entering battle, switching scenes, or performing other actions.
entries.jin_skilldes::ga_jin_melee_background: <Italic>"Finally, someone clueless comes along who actually wants to buy something from the shop, but if it wasn't for Hotori refusing to budge, hmph… this month's sales wouldn't be a big fat zero."</><cf><Italic>"That little brat, didn't you see what kind of price he was trying to haggle? He's treating our Eibon like we're some charity case! I was being nice not calling Daff over to rough him up!"</>
entries.jin_skilldes::ga_jin_passive_1_backgroun: <Italic>At least when this proprietress, who can usually chatter on endlessly about every penny, finally quiets down and sits peacefully sipping wine while admiring the moon, you can still notice… she is an elegant and graceful person.</>
entries.jin_skilldes::ga_jin_passive_1_des: <TextHLT>Blossom Enhancement</>: Prevents Vita Bud attacks from pausing during Time Stop.
entries.jin_skilldes::ga_jin_passive_2_backgroun: <Italic>Cheers! Celebrate! Let's… let's celebrate again! My treasures… my precious treasures… they're all mine now! Deal… deal! Hehehe… hic… guard them all… for me… zzZ…</>
entries.jin_skilldes::ga_jin_passive_2_des: Increases World's Tide's Finisher DMG Ratio by <NumGreen>100%</>.
entries.jin_skilldes::ga_jin_passive_3_backgroun: <Italic>Walk alone outside of time, and see the truth of time.</>
entries.jin_skilldes::ga_jin_perfectevade_des: Triggers when using Misty Moon Style after a Critical Dodge. Raises the umbrella to counterattack opponents instantly, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> and reducing Break.
entries.jin_skilldes::ga_jin_qte_background: <Italic>For Hotori, this is merely a small display of her abilities, but difficult customers who threaten to complain will learn exactly why this humble little shop dares to impose such strict terms.</>
entries.jin_skilldes::ga_jin_qte_des: Time to teach these rude guests some manners. Throws the umbrella, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to an area.
entries.jin_skilldes::ga_jin_skill1_des: Requires no cooldown for Present Replay.<cf>Allows Hotori to spend <NumGreen>60</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&JinTime">Non-Closed Timepiece</> energy to cast Present Replay when energy is greater than <NumGreen>60</>. Deals <NumGreen>7</> instances of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to an area. Records Support Skills and Redirect Skills used by allies for the next <NumGreen>5</>s, appreciating up to <NumGreen>3</> timings per use, with each character recorded at most once.<cf>Rewinds the Non-Closed Timepiece pointer continuously during use. Stops recording after the pointer rewinds a certain amount, and continues rewinding a fixed amount if recording completes early. Clears records when entering or leaving battle. Overwrites existing records when using Present Replay again.
entries.jin_skilldes::ga_jin_star1_des: Increases Hotori's damage during Time Stop by <NumGreen>12%</> for each recorded Support Skill or Redirect Skill.
entries.jin_skilldes::ga_jin_star2_des: Increases Hotori's damage by <NumGreen>20%</> during Time Stop.
entries.jin_skilldes::ga_jin_star3_des: Recovers the energy spent on Present Replay after using it and completing the recording. Triggers at most once every <NumGreen>60s</>. Interrupts energy restoration if energy is spent during the recovery process.
entries.jin_skilldes::ga_jin_star4_des: Grants an additional <NumGreen>10</> energy to the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&JinTime">Non-Closed Timepiece</> for every <NumGreen>1</> target defeated by the Team while the pointer is not rewinding, up to <NumGreen>3</> times. Resets the count when casting World's Tide.
entries.jin_skilldes::ga_jin_star5_des: When Hotori is deployed, if there is only <NumGreen>1</> enemy on the field, the entire team's damage against that target is increased by <NumGreen>15%</>. This effect is lost when Hotori is down.
entries.jin_skilldes::ga_jin_star6_des: Hotori ignores <NumGreen>30%</> of the target's DEF during Time Stop.
entries.jin_skilldes::ga_jin_starextra1_des: Increases the skill level of Misty Moon Style, Present Replay, and World's Tide by 1.
entries.jin_skilldes::ga_jin_starextra2_des: Grants all team members 30% ATK while Hotori is on the team and alive.
entries.jin_skilldes::ga_jin_starextra2_name: The Ultimate Treasure of Clear Understanding
entries.jin_skilldes::ga_jin_utraskill_des: Has no cooldown or Ultimate Energy cost for World's Tide.<cf>Allows Hotori to unleash World's Tide when <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&JinTime">Non-Closed Timepiece</> energy is fully charged, dealing <NumGreen>10</> instances of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to an area. Draws a katana from the umbrella handle and changes attack mode. Slows surrounding time to near standstill for a period, disabling character switching. Cleanses any received time control debuffs and grants immunity to time control debuffs during Time Stop. Replays all attacks recorded by Present Replay <NumGreen>1</> time and clears the records if any exist.<cf>Rewinds the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&JinTime">Non-Closed Timepiece</> pointer continuously during Time Stop. Builds combo stacks with Hotori's katana attacks, increasing damage per hit. Deals Finisher DMG when combo stacks reach <NumGreen>10</>. Ends time stop when the pointer rewinds completely or when Finisher DMG is dealt.
entries.kuhara_skilldes::ga_kuhara_melee1_des: Dual-wields to perform up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</>. Grants <NumGreen>2</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaPowerBullet">Rose Pact Bullets</>. Establishes a <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">Lethal Rose Pact</> with the target when the final hit strikes.
entries.kuhara_skilldes::ga_kuhara_melee2_des: Wields her weapon while airborne and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.
entries.kuhara_skilldes::ga_kuhara_melee3_des: Hold Basic Attack to trigger. Auto-targets and fires a bullet, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</>. Consumes <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaPowerBullet">Rose Pact Bullets</> for continuous fire and prioritizes targets with <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">Lethal Rose Pact</> when <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaPowerBullet">Rose Pact Bullets</> are available.
entries.kuhara_skilldes::ga_kuhara_melee4_des: Press Aim to enter Aim mode. Fires a bullet that deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to the enemy in the crosshair.
entries.kuhara_skilldes::ga_kuhara_melee_backgro: <Italic>"She glides through the city like a phantom, where light and shadow dance. Weaving secrets from whispers and fleeting leads, every move is a quiet vow to seal each deal in flawless harmony."</>
entries.kuhara_skilldes::ga_kuhara_passive_1_bac: <Italic>Went as smoothly as I thought it would.</>
entries.kuhara_skilldes::ga_kuhara_passive_1_des: <TextHLT>Blossom Enhancement</>: Spawns 1 additional Vita Bud and increases Vita Bud limit on field to 6.
entries.kuhara_skilldes::ga_kuhara_passive_2_bac: <Italic>People say opportunities are rare, but I've always been good at seizing them.</>
entries.kuhara_skilldes::ga_kuhara_passive_2_des: Binds targets not affected by <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">Fatal Rose Pact</> when Vita Pistils hit them. Triggers an additional settlement on targets already bound, causing them to take an extra <NumGreen>15%</> × <Ling>Anima DMG</>.
entries.kuhara_skilldes::ga_kuhara_perfectevade_: Triggers when using When Secrets Take Shape after a Critical Dodge. Swings both arms and fires in a cross pattern at targets in front, binding them with <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">Lethal Rose Pact</> while dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</>, reducing Break, and granting <NumGreen>2</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaPowerBullet">Rose Pact Bullets</>.
entries.kuhara_skilldes::ga_kuhara_qte_backgroun: <Italic>Don't worry, I've always had an excellent memory.</>
entries.kuhara_skilldes::ga_kuhara_qte_des: Fires a curved bullet, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> and granting <NumGreen>2</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaPowerBullet">Rose Pact Bullets</> upon hit.
entries.kuhara_skilldes::ga_kuhara_skill_des: Dashes across the battlefield, pulling the target into the range of control and attacking. Deals multiple instances of <Ling>Anima DMG</> and grants <NumGreen>4</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaPowerBullet">Rose Pact Bullets</> while establishing a <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">Lethal Rose Pact</>.
entries.kuhara_skilldes::ga_kuhara_star1_des: Increases Jiuyuan's ATK by <NumGreen>5%</> for each target on the field bound by <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">Lethal Rose Pact</>, up to <NumGreen>15%</>.
entries.kuhara_skilldes::ga_kuhara_star2_des: Increases <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">Lethal Rose Pact</> DMG Ratio by <NumGreen>100%</>. Restores HP to the entire team equal to <NumGreen>5%</> of the total damage accumulated by that Rose Pact whenever <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaBudBoom">Pact Settlement</> is triggered by casting Final Reckoning.
entries.kuhara_skilldes::ga_kuhara_star3_des: Deducts an additional <NumGreen>4</> Break from the settlement target when <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaBudBoom">Pact Settlement</> is triggered by casting Final Reckoning.
entries.kuhara_skilldes::ga_kuhara_star4_des: Increases DMG Ratio by <NumGreen>50%</> and affects targets within range when <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaBudBoom">Pact Settlement</> is actively triggered.
entries.kuhara_skilldes::ga_kuhara_star5_des: Jiuyuan's DMG against targets bound by <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">Lethal Rose Pact</> increases by <NumGreen>8%</>.
entries.kuhara_skilldes::ga_kuhara_star6_des: Deals <NumGreen>200%</> DMG Ratio to targets bound by <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">Lethal Rose Pact</> each time they cast a skill. This effect has a <NumGreen>5s</> cooldown.
entries.kuhara_skilldes::ga_kuhara_starextra1_de: Increases the skill level of When Secrets Take Shape, Intel Hunter, and Final Reckoning by 1.
entries.kuhara_skilldes::ga_kuhara_starextra2_de: Reduces Anima Resistance of targets bound by <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">Lethal Rose Pact</> by <NumGreen>10%</>.
entries.kuhara_skilldes::ga_kuhara_ultraskill_ba: <Italic>A faint stir in the air. Alas… merely a fleeting foe.</>
entries.kuhara_skilldes::ga_kuhara_ultraskill_de: Dashes across the battlefield at high speed, continuously firing on surrounding targets before ending with a large-scale explosion, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</>.<cf>Triggers Final Reckoning, causing all <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaAttachment">Lethal Rose Pact</> targets within range to enter a stage where <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&KuharaBudBoom">Pact Settlement</> can be triggered, executing all settlements simultaneously on the final hit.
entries.lacrimosa_skilldes::ga_lacrimosa_melee2_: Hold to enter Aim mode. Deals 1 instance of <An>Chaos DMG</> to an enemy in the crosshair and learns their combat technique.<cf>Temporarily forgets Morning Tomato and uses the learned technique upon successful learning.<cf>Learned techniques are stored permanently in Lacrimosa's memory. New techniques can be learned to replace existing ones, or Lacrimosa can actively forget a technique on the Skill page to recall Morning Tomato.
entries.lacrimosa_skilldes::ga_lacrimosa_melee3_: Manipulates Esper Ability Constructs in the air and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <An>Chaos DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.
entries.lacrimosa_skilldes::ga_lacrimosa_melee4_: Swings her Frying Pan, performing up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <An>Chaos DMG</>.<cf>The projectile generated by the 2nd attack can be shattered by subsequent attacks, causing an explosion and dealing extra <An>Chaos DMG</>.
entries.lacrimosa_skilldes::ga_lacrimosa_melee_b: <Italic>At first, there were no roads. Then Lacrimosa made lots of vehicles and road signs, and suddenly roads appeared. The problem? Too many signs with contradictory rules. How are you supposed to turn left and right at the same time?</>
entries.lacrimosa_skilldes::ga_lacrimosa_melee_d: Manipulates Red Jelly, performing up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <An>Chaos DMG</>.

Inflicts <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">Nightmare</> on the target when attacks hit, up to 10 stacks.<cf>Inflicts 1 stack of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">Nightmare</> per damage instance when a single Basic Attack deals multiple instances of damage.
entries.lacrimosa_skilldes::ga_lacrimosa_melee_s: Flavor Variation can be used at any time via the Aim button.<cf>Tosses her Frying Pan and performs a flying kick forward when using Tomato Metal, dealing 1 instance of <An>Chaos DMG</> to each target hit. Switches her attack module to Tomato Percussion.<cf>Leaps into the air and slams the ground, dealing 1 instance of AoE <An>Chaos DMG</> when using Tomato Percussion. Switches her attack module to Tomato Metal.<cf>The current Basic Attack style determines the attack pattern of Working Day Judgement.
entries.lacrimosa_skilldes::ga_lacrimosa_passive: <Italic>Weekday morning alarms… magic, mess with memory.</><cf><Italic>"So this is your excuse for being late?"</><cf><Italic>"Alarm 1, Alarm 2, Lacrimosa turned them all off. But… ah… Lacrimosa can't remember…"</>
<TextHLT>Discord Enhancement</>: Deals additional DMG equal to 400% of ATK to the target when Discord is triggered, if the target is already Broken.
<Italic>One person's sweet dream can be another's nightmare. Makes you wonder… why don't people wake themselves up with their sleep talking?</>

Grants <NumGreen>1</> additional attempt of Morning Tomato after Lacrimosa uses Tomato Metal or Tomato Percussion <NumGreen>5</> times during the skill cooldown. Activates only <NumGreen>1</> time per skill cooldown.
<Italic>"Lacrimosa can fly. But glass… always hit it. Hate it. And when Lacrimosa sleeps… down from the sky!"</>
Lacrimosa transforms into a bat in her dream, flying freely. When out of combat, hold dodge to enter flight. Flight costs stamina.
entries.lacrimosa_skilldes::ga_lacrimosa_perfect: Triggers when using Basic Attacks after a Critical Dodge. Seizes the opening created by the enemy's missed attack and violently hurls a large amount of Red Jelly onto the enemy's head, dealing <NumGreen>6</> instances of <An>Chaos DMG</> to an area and reducing Break.
entries.lacrimosa_skilldes::ga_lacrimosa_qte_bac: <Italic>Lacrimosa couldn't care less about villain arcs and tragic backstories. She just wants to clock out and go home to sleep.</>
entries.lacrimosa_skilldes::ga_lacrimosa_qte_des: Lacrimosa get this done, and Lacrimosa get to sleep… Manipulates Esper Ability Constructs, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <An>Chaos DMG</> to an area.
entries.lacrimosa_skilldes::ga_lacrimosa_skill1_: Ah… Achoo! Throws a barrage of unfinished Esper Ability Constructs, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <An>Chaos DMG</> to all targets within the area and inflicting <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">Nightmare</> on the targets.<cf>Combos into the <NumGreen>5</>th instance of Tomato Metal or Tomato Percussion after casting Morning Tomato.
entries.lacrimosa_skilldes::ga_lacrimosa_skill2_: Lacrimosa... can do it too.<cf>Lacrimosa uses her Esper Ability to copy and cast an enemy's skill, triggering the corresponding additional effects. The skill duration matches that of the original owner. During the cast, Lacrimosa cannot move, but she can manually cancel the cast or switch to another character. Lacrimosa takes damage if she is attacked during the cast.<cf>Casting Devilish Gift grants Lacrimosa a percentage of the original skill owner's ATK.
entries.lacrimosa_skilldes::ga_lacrimosa_skill_b: <Italic>"Ah. Lacrimosa… didn't mean to…"</><cf><Italic>"Haha, nice work there, Mosa! Let's have Skia buy you some ice cream!"</><cf><Italic>"Baicang, nosy. Ice cream… three scoops…"</>
entries.lacrimosa_skilldes::ga_lacrimosa_star1_d: Allows Lacrimosa to automatically cast her Support Skill and trigger the corresponding cycle without Cycle Energy accumulation when switching to her from any character that can trigger Esper Cycle: Nova, Scorch, or Discord within <NumGreen>5</>s after casting Devilish Gift. Triggers up to <NumGreen>once</> per <NumGreen>5</>s.
entries.lacrimosa_skilldes::ga_lacrimosa_star2_d: Increases Lacrimosa's damage dealt by <NumGreen>15%</> for <NumGreen>15</>s when she switches in using a Support Skill.
entries.lacrimosa_skilldes::ga_lacrimosa_star3_d: Triggers all accumulated <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">Nightmare</> effects on the target at once when the <NumGreen>5</>th hit of Tomato Metal or Tomato Percussion lands.
entries.lacrimosa_skilldes::ga_lacrimosa_star5_d: Reduces the target's Max HP by <NumGreen>200%</> of the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">Nightmare</> DMG dealt when dealing <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">Nightmare</> DMG. Restores her HP every <NumGreen>3</>s based on the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">Nightmare</> DMG dealt during that period, restoring HP equal to <NumGreen>1.5%</> of the total <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">Nightmare</> DMG dealt. Prevents <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">Nightmare</> stacks from being removed when the target is healed.
entries.lacrimosa_skilldes::ga_lacrimosa_star6_d: Increases the DMG Ratio of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">Nightmare</> to <NumGreen>{0}%</> at the current skill level.
entries.lacrimosa_skilldes::ga_lacrimosa_starext: Increases the skill level of Sweet and Sour, Morning Tomato, Devilish Gift, and Working Day Judgement by <NumGreen>1</>. Reduces the Stamina cost to <NumGreen>85%</> while flying in bat form.
Lacrimosa's damage ignores <NumGreen>20%</> of the target's DEF. Reduces the Stamina cost to <NumGreen>70%</> while flying in bat form.
entries.lacrimosa_skilldes::ga_lacrimosa_ultrask: <Italic>A friendly reminder from Barracuda, BAC's Professional Maintenance Staff: ETD-4 has exhausted their free maintenance quota for this month. Future repair costs will be deducted from the performance bonus of those who file the requests. CERTAIN team members are kindly reminded to take better care of Bureau property, especially non-reinforced glass items and sensitive electronic equipment. CERTAIN team members needing items from the vending machine should seek assistance from their squad captain or lieutenant.</>
entries.lacrimosa_skilldes::ga_lacrimosa_utraski: Controls the Truck when using Tomato Metal, dealing 10 instances of <An>Chaos DMG</> to an area and inflicting <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">Nightmare</> on all targets in range.<cf><cf>Dismantles the Car when using Tomato Percussion, dealing 5 instances of <An>Chaos DMG</> to an area and inflicting <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&Lacrimosa_dot">Nightmare</> on all targets in range.
entries.linko_skilldes::ga_linko_melee1_des: 释放「普通攻击：恶灵CQC」，灵可进行至多5段的连续攻击，造成<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>。每段攻击将积攒「谐频」点数。<cf>「谐频」将在使用「变轨技能：瞬息全频振」时消耗，并强化其触发的<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">「同频合击」</>。
entries.linko_skilldes::ga_linko_melee2_des: Hold Basic Attack during Poltergeist CQC to make Linko strike the current target with both palms, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</>.
entries.linko_skilldes::ga_linko_melee3_des: Press Basic Attack while airborne to plunge, dealing 1 instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> in an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height by up to 100%.
entries.linko_skilldes::ga_linko_melee4_des: Sends Xiaozhen to ambush the target every 8s while Linko is off-field, causing Xiaozhen to attack once and inflict a <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoXiaozhenMark">Hit 'Em Here!</> mark.
entries.linko_skilldes::ga_linko_melee_backgroun: <Italic>「小贞小贞，我有一个想法……用你的手打出欧拉拳套一样的拳击！快到全是残影的那种！」</><cf><Italic>「……那是图个啥？全力一拳撂倒不是更高效吗？」</><cf><Italic>「你不懂！这是格斗的艺术！」</>
entries.linko_skilldes::ga_linko_passive_1_backg: <Italic>那频段中的噪点，如同一道难以察觉的裂纹，这道伤痕为什么出现？又为什么无法愈合？</><cf><Italic>在某个瞬间，她甚至会为此感到难过。</>
entries.linko_skilldes::ga_linko_passive_1_des: Increases the additional Follow-up Attack DMG from Hexed to 30% while Linko is on the team. Targets affected by Hexed take 10% more Follow-up Attack DMG.
entries.linko_skilldes::ga_linko_passive_2_backg: <Italic>言语和文字不能传达万分之一的感受，而此刻，我们的灵魂将百分之百地相拥。</>
entries.linko_skilldes::ga_linko_passive_2_des: Reduces the target's Esper Ability Resistance corresponding to the attribute of the character who triggers <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</> by 8% for 12s. Resistance Reduction effects for different attributes can coexist on the same target. Effects of the same attribute inflicted by <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</> do not stack. Resets the duration when triggered again.
entries.linko_skilldes::ga_linko_perfectevade_de: Triggers when using Poltergeist CQC after a Critical Dodge. Charges toward the target, dealing 4 instances of <Ling>Anima DMG</> in an area and building up Modulation.
entries.linko_skilldes::ga_linko_qte_background: <Italic>「假如小贞不在身边，而我遇到了坏人的话……」</><cf><Italic>「直接逃呗，你那小短腿不是跑得挺快的。」</><cf><Italic>「才不要——噢！我可以抡着电视机砸上去！」</><cf><Italic>「不行……绝！对！不！行！」</>
entries.linko_skilldes::ga_linko_qte_des: Strikes the target together with Xiaozhen, dealing 1 instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> in an area.<cf>Summons an ally to perform a <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</> by breaking a <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoXiaozhenMark">Hit 'Em Here!</> mark, casting Full-Frequency Pulse, or casting Oversync. Scales <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</>'s DMG Ratio with Spectral Cross's skill level.
entries.linko_skilldes::ga_linko_skill1_des: Channels Esper Ability upon casting Full-Frequency Pulse, bombarding the target with ghost energy to deal up to 4 instances of <Ling>Anima DMG</> and calling Xiaozhen or an ally to perform a <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</>. Opens a selection wheel to choose Xiaozhen or an ally, and performs the selected character's <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</>, dealing DMG of the corresponding attribute.
