Grants this <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</> a DMG Bonus and consumes all accumulated Modulation, converting it into an additional DMG Bonus.<cf>Briefly pauses the battle timer while selecting the attacker and initiating the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</>.<cf>Replaces an ally's position on the wheel with Xiaozhen if the ally is unable to act or is not on the team. Grants Xiaozhen's <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</> an additional DMG Bonus for each additional Xiaozhen on the wheel.
entries.linko_skilldes::ga_linko_skill_backgroun: <Italic>"Watch this! Our red-hot tag-team finisher…"</><cf><Italic>"…Wait, kid. Did we even know that person?"</><cf><Italic>"Didn't catch who it was, but the combo worked!"</>
entries.linko_skilldes::ga_linko_specialability_: <Italic>「糟糕！要迟到了！小贞，快启动紧急弹射程序，目的地异象管理局二楼窗户！」</><cf><Italic>「……你就不能正常走电话亭吗？」</>
Hold Basic Attack while out of combat to charge up using Xiaozhen's ghostly arm. Release to launch Linko forward. Increases launch force with charge time, up to a maximum charge time of 2s.
entries.linko_skilldes::ga_linko_star1_des: Reduces Spectral Rush's appearance interval by <NumGreen>25%</> while Linko is off-field.
entries.linko_skilldes::ga_linko_star2_des: 「极轨终结：超负荷共鸣」的<Ling>灵属性爆发伤害</>的倍率提升<NumGreen>30%</>。
entries.linko_skilldes::ga_linko_star3_des: Resets Full-Frequency Pulse's cooldown upon casting Oversync.
entries.linko_skilldes::ga_linko_star4_des: 在「共鸣领域」内，每次触发<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">「同频合击」</>时额外造成一次范围性<Ling>灵属性异能伤害</>，当前「极轨终结：超负荷共鸣！」技能等级下的倍率为<NumGreen>{0}%</>。该攻击可消耗<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoXiaozhenMark">「小鬼打这里！」</>标记并触发<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">「同频合击」</>。
entries.linko_skilldes::ga_linko_star5_des: 「变轨技能：瞬息全频振」触发的<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">「同频合击」</>可以触发环合效果。若所选队友与灵可无法发生环合，则本次<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">「同频合击」</>获得<NumGreen>50%</>增伤。
entries.linko_skilldes::ga_linko_star6_des: Increases allies' <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strike</> Crit Rate by <NumGreen>25%</> while Linko is on the team. Grants allies' <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strikes</> the Charge effect.
entries.linko_skilldes::ga_linko_starextra1_des: 「援护技：恶灵左直拳！」、「变轨技能：瞬息全频振」、「极轨终结：超负荷共鸣」的技能等级提升<NumGreen>1</>级；灵可自身的攻击力提升<NumGreen>20%</>。
entries.linko_skilldes::ga_linko_starextra2_des: 「共鸣领域」持续时间延长<NumGreen>5</>秒，期间全队获得<NumGreen>30%</>灵和咒属性增伤。
entries.linko_skilldes::ga_linko_ultraskill_back: <Italic>没有无法接通的频道，没有无法触达的孤岛，没有无法回应的呼唤，没有无法跨越的阻隔……</><cf><Italic>因为电波终将指引我们相遇，即使初见也如久别重逢。</>
entries.linko_skilldes::ga_linko_utraskill_des: Enters Overdrive upon casting Oversync, deploying a Resonance Field for a set duration and Syncing with up to 3 allies. Press Redirect Skill to call on Synced allies in sequence to perform <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strikes</> that deal Area DMG, up to 3 times.<cf>Ends Overdrive when its duration expires or when Oversync is pressed again, releasing an overloaded noise burst that deals multiple instances of <Ling>Anima Area DMG</> and 1 instance of <Ling>Anima Burst DMG</> to all enemies within Resonance Field. Increases this <Ling>Anima Burst DMG</> based on the number of different debuffs on each target.<cf>Extends Resonance Field for a set duration after Overdrive ends. Counts Support Skills triggered by allies within Resonance Field as <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&LinkoLTE">Synced Strikes</>, treats their DMG as Follow-up Attack DMG, and grants them the bonuses from Precision Tuning, Starlit Whispers, and The World Answers.
entries.mint_skilldes::ga_mint_melee1_des: Wields her weapon and performs up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</>.
entries.mint_skilldes::ga_mint_melee2_des: Wields her weapon in the air and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.
entries.mint_skilldes::ga_mint_melee_background: <Italic>"First place in the Containment Simulation Exam: Mint, from CSU-2."</>
entries.mint_skilldes::ga_mint_passive_1_backgro: <Italic>"Watch closely now! I'm not the same as before! You're now face-to-face with an elite operative!"</>
entries.mint_skilldes::ga_mint_passive_1_des: <TextHLT>Blossom Enhancement</>: Expands Vita Pistils' damage area on hit.
entries.mint_skilldes::ga_mint_passive_2_backgro: <Italic>There's always that extra burst of energy when work's almost done, especially when putting out new arrivals…</><cf><Italic>"Five minutes till close! Line up nicely and get nullified!"</>
entries.mint_skilldes::ga_mint_passive_2_des: While Mint is on the field, her DEF is increased by <NumGreen>20%</> and her resistance to Interruptions is increased by <NumGreen>30%</>.
entries.mint_skilldes::ga_mint_passive_3_des: Hold Basic Attack to make Mint dance and spin, forming a tornado that continuously drains Stamina and deals continuous <Ling>Anima DMG</> to surrounding enemies.
entries.mint_skilldes::ga_mint_perfectevade_des: Triggers when using Perfect Containment after a Critical Dodge. Leaps up to dodge an attack, seizes the enemy's opening, and swiftly swings her weapon, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area and reducing Break.
entries.mint_skilldes::ga_mint_qte_des: Perfect finishing work from an elite member! Charges and leaps into the air, performing a penetrating attack on enemies, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area.
entries.mint_skilldes::ga_mint_skill_background: <Italic>"Ice cream is cool, mint is cool, so mint ice cream from Blizzi means double the happiness! Ooha… I'm already shivering just thinking about it!"</>
entries.mint_skilldes::ga_mint_skill_des: Time to cool things down! Dashes forward, then returns to her original position, dealing <NumGreen>2</> instances of AoE <Ling>Anima DMG</> to enemies along the path.
entries.mint_skilldes::ga_mint_star1_des: Resets the cooldown of Ultimate: Super Claws when Caramel Crisp hits an enemy. Triggers once every <NumGreen>3s</>.
entries.mint_skilldes::ga_mint_star2_des: Redirect Skill: Ultimate: Super Claws damage increases by <NumGreen>40%</>.
entries.mint_skilldes::ga_mint_star3_des: When any character triggers Blossom or Hexed against an enemy, Mint's ATK is increased by <NumGreen>15%</> for <NumGreen>15s</>.
entries.mint_skilldes::ga_mint_star4_des: Increases Mint's Crit Chance by <NumGreen>12%</> when dealing damage to the last enemy on the field.
entries.mint_skilldes::ga_mint_star5_des: After casting Redirect Skill: Ultimate: Super Claws, Mint's CRIT DMG increases by <NumGreen>25%</> for <NumGreen>6s</>.
entries.mint_skilldes::ga_mint_star6_des: Mint deals <NumGreen>15%</> increased damage to targets below <NumGreen>40%</> HP.
entries.mint_skilldes::ga_mint_starextra1_des: Increases the skill level of Perfect Containment, Ultimate: Super Claws, and Ultimate: Thunderous Whirlwind Slash by <NumGreen>1</>.
entries.mint_skilldes::ga_mint_starextra2_des: Grants an additional <NumGreen>2</> Cycle Energy after successfully casting Ultimate: Super Claws.
entries.mint_skilldes::ga_mint_utraskill_backgro: <Italic>The full name is "Mint's Ultimate: Super Duper Ultra 360 Whirlwind Slash", but I had to shorten it to what it is now because people wouldn't stop laughing about it.</>
entries.mint_skilldes::ga_mint_utraskill_des: Are you ready! Channels the surrounding wind into her dual blades, transforming them into wind blades that deal multiple instances of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area. Lands with a final hit that deals massive <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area.
entries.mitsuki_skilldes::ga_mitsuki_melee1_des: Sing smoothly and naturally! Wields her weapon and performs up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <Hun>Psyche DMG</>.
entries.mitsuki_skilldes::ga_mitsuki_melee2_des: Sing loudly and fully! Hold Dodge while moving to ride a jellyfish, sprinting at high speed for the duration. Generates a jellyfish blast at intervals when targets are nearby, dealing <Hun>Psyche DMG</>.<cf>Performs a special Dodge in this state, and "Critical Dodge Riposte: Syncopation" automatically fires four jellyfish blasts.<cf>Ends automatically when stamina drops below a certain amount.
entries.mitsuki_skilldes::ga_mitsuki_melee3_des: Sing clearly and beautifully! Wields the weapon mid-air and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.
entries.mitsuki_skilldes::ga_mitsuki_melee_backg: <Italic>Vocal technique is key for any conductor, so I keep practicing. Engage the core, relax the jaw, let the sound flow from the back of my head and out through my brow…</><cf><Italic>"Ah—ah—"</><cf><Italic>…Why does it feel like even my own voice is slipping away?</>
entries.mitsuki_skilldes::ga_mitsuki_passive_1_b: <Italic>How do you prove that sound is a wave? Toss a stone into water and see the ripples spread; toss a stone at someone, and you’ll hear wave after wave of noise.</><cf><Italic>"…Am I supposed to laugh?"</><cf><Italic>"Aurelia's jokes aren't funny at all—"</><cf><Italic>"No way! People used to eat that up… you kids just have your humor standards way too high."</>
entries.mitsuki_skilldes::ga_mitsuki_passive_1_d: <TextHLT>Nova Enhancement</>: Deals 3 instances of <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to the target after their Nova status ends, each equal to 50% of ATK.
entries.mitsuki_skilldes::ga_mitsuki_passive_2_b: <Italic>Strong… stronger… Super Sound… Ultimate Sound! Want it even louder? Then the drummer will just have to throw themselves into the drum headfirst!</>
entries.mitsuki_skilldes::ga_mitsuki_passive_2_d: Increases Aurelia's ATK by <NumGreen>1%</> for <NumGreen>5</>s when a jellyfish blast hits a target, up to <NumGreen>10</> stacks.
entries.mitsuki_skilldes::ga_mitsuki_passive_3_b: <Italic>Being unable to take a single step doesn't mean you can't keep moving forward. Let your heart be as free and boundless as the world—once you set out, there's nowhere you can't reach.</>
entries.mitsuki_skilldes::ga_mitsuki_passive_3_d: Aurelia rides a jellyfish, gliding effortlessly through the city's streets and alleys. She can't climb or vault over obstacles, but her jump is higher, and she gains special gliding and swimming abilities.
entries.mitsuki_skilldes::ga_mitsuki_perfectevad: Triggers when casting Legato after a Critical Dodge.<cf>Think you can handle my rhythm? Wields her weapon to deal <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to an area and reduces Break.
entries.mitsuki_skilldes::ga_mitsuki_qte_des: True command means never mistaking the timing. Commands the jellyfish to strike, dealing 1 instance of AoE <Hun>Psyche DMG</> on hit.
entries.mitsuki_skilldes::ga_mitsuki_skill_backg: <Italic>If she hadn't joined the Tamamochi Street Resident Association, Aurelia might have ended up as an administrator on Cadenza Street instead. In the end, perhaps it's all just a matter of fate.</>
entries.mitsuki_skilldes::ga_mitsuki_skill_des: Transform the everyday into a rainbow melody and let it roar across the skyline. Deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of AoE <Hun>Psyche DMG</> and enters the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&MitsukiSkill">Cadenza</> state for <NumGreen>12</>s.
entries.mitsuki_skilldes::ga_mitsuki_star1_des: Increases Crit Rate by <NumGreen>15%</> while in the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&MitsukiSkill">Cadenza</> state.
entries.mitsuki_skilldes::ga_mitsuki_star2_des: Enters the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&MitsukiSkill">Cadenza</> state for <NumGreen>5</>s after a successful Critical Dodge or casting Dissonance. Extends the duration by <NumGreen>5</>s if the state's already active. The <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&MitsukiSkill">Cadenza</> state lasts for up to <NumGreen>12</>s.
entries.mitsuki_skilldes::ga_mitsuki_star3_des: Increases Canon Chorus DMG by <NumGreen>20%</> while in the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&MitsukiSkill">Cadenza</> state.
entries.mitsuki_skilldes::ga_mitsuki_star4_des: Increases Aurelia's DEF by <NumGreen>20%</> when casting Staccato.
entries.mitsuki_skilldes::ga_mitsuki_star5_des: Increases Canon Chorus's Crit Rate by <NumGreen>15%</>.
entries.mitsuki_skilldes::ga_mitsuki_star6_des: Increases the maximum stacks of Crescendo to 20. Grants 10 Crescendo stacks after casting Cadenza Aria.
entries.mitsuki_skilldes::ga_mitsuki_starextra1_: Increases the skill levels of Cappella, Cadenza Aria, and Canon Chorus by <NumGreen>1</>.
entries.mitsuki_skilldes::ga_mitsuki_starextra2_: Increases all allies' <Hun>Psyche DMG</> by <NumGreen>8%</> for <NumGreen>15</>s when entering the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&MitsukiSkill">Cadenza</> state or when <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&MitsukiSkill">its</> duration is extended. Resets the duration when reapplied.
entries.mitsuki_skilldes::ga_mitsuki_ultraskill_: <Italic>Whether it was the school choir or that short-lived, chaotic band, these were Aurelia's most cherished memories. Even a brilliant solo would feel far too lonely.</>
Let's play the next verse together. Gathers nearby jellyfish, dealing 6 instances of AoE <Hun>Psyche DMG</> and slightly pulling targets together.
entries.nanally_skilldes::ga_nanally_melee1_des: Bares her fangs and brandishes her claws, performing up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</>. Dodging does not interrupt the combo.
entries.nanally_skilldes::ga_nanally_melee2_des: Enters aim mode, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of single-target <Ling>Anima DMG</> to the enemy in the crosshair.
entries.nanally_skilldes::ga_nanally_melee3_des: Swings her claws in the air and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.
entries.nanally_skilldes::ga_nanally_melee4_des: Triggers by holding Basic Attack. Performs up to 3 powerful attacks, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</>. Chains after Critical Riposte and the 1st, 2nd, 3rd, and 5th attacks of Colucci Secret Skill. Dodging does not interrupt the combo.
entries.nanally_skilldes::ga_nanally_melee_backg: <Italic>Said to be a secret combat technique passed down in the Coluccis, though it clearly incorporates many street-fighting elements from Hethereau.</>
entries.nanally_skilldes::ga_nanally_passive_1_b: <Italic>The First Rule of Gang Wars: "Watch your back."</>
entries.nanally_skilldes::ga_nanally_passive_1_d: <TextHLT>Blossom Enhancement</>: Fires 10 Vita Pistils with Vita Bud, reducing the interval between each shot to 1s.
entries.nanally_skilldes::ga_nanally_passive_2_b: <Italic>"Hey, hey, hey! The duel's already started! Running soooo far away… Chickening out, huh?"</>
entries.nanally_skilldes::ga_nanally_passive_2_d: Applies <NumGreen>1</> <TextHLT>follow-up attack</> to a single enemy, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</> of <NumGreen>60%</> ATK whenever any ally deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of Esper Cycle DMG while Nanally is in <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&NanallyWalkOnWall">Ichi-daime's Authority</> state. DMG Ratio scales with Basic Attack skill level, reaching <NumGreen>129.5%</> at Lvl 11.<cf>Triggers <NumGreen>once</> every <NumGreen>2s</>.
entries.nanally_skilldes::ga_nanally_perfectevad: Triggers when using Colucci Secret Skill after a Critical Dodge. Charges toward the target at full speed, planting one hand on the ground, delivering a roundhouse kick that deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area, and reducing Break.
entries.nanally_skilldes::ga_nanally_qte_backgro: <Italic>Got a problem? Come find Nanally - I've got you covered!</>
entries.nanally_skilldes::ga_nanally_qte_des: Time to get serious! Charges with a spinning motion, delivering a kick and dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area.
entries.nanally_skilldes::ga_nanally_skill_backg: <Italic>Mint tried to learn this move from Nanally, but the moment she saw that Nanally's hair went rough, curved, split, and knotted, she gave up the idea. Adler is not with her in the Bureau of Anomaly Control to take care of her hair, after all.</>
entries.nanally_skilldes::ga_nanally_skill_des_1: Hehe, surprise time! Deals <NumGreen>5</> instances of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to surrounding enemies and wraps herself in Anima Esper Ability, gaining the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&NanallyWalkOnWall">Ichi-daime's Authority</> effect.<cf>Lasts <NumGreen>12s</> or until Nanally is switched out.<cf>Ends <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&NanallyWalkOnWall">Ichi-daime's Authority</> early when recast.
entries.nanally_skilldes::ga_nanally_star1_des: Grants Nanally <NumGreen>2.5</> Ultimate Energy for <NumGreen>each</> <TextHLT>follow-up attack</> she performs. Triggers at most <NumGreen>once</> every <NumGreen>1s</>.
entries.nanally_skilldes::ga_nanally_star3_des: Applies <NumGreen>1</> <TextHLT>follow-up attack</> to a single enemy, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</> of <NumGreen>{0}%</> ATK whenever Nanally deals damage to an enemy while she's in <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&NanallyWalkOnWall">Ichi-daime's Authority</> state. DMG Ratio scales with Basic Attack skill level, reaching <NumGreen>107.9%</> at Lvl 11. Triggers <NumGreen>once</> per second.
entries.nanally_skilldes::ga_nanally_star5_des: Increases Nanally's ATK by <NumGreen>2%</> for <NumGreen>each</> <TextHLT>follow-up attack</> she performs, up to <NumGreen>20%</>. Disappears when Nanally leaves the battlefield or exits combat.
entries.nanally_skilldes::ga_nanally_star6_des: Extends the duration of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&NanallyWalkOnWall">Ichi-daime's Authority</> state to <NumGreen>15s</>, and further extends it to <NumGreen>20s</> when out of combat.
entries.nanally_skilldes::ga_nanally_starextra1_: Increases the skill level of Colucci Secret Skill, Colucci Howling Technique, and Colucci Ultimate Technique by 1.
entries.nanally_skilldes::ga_nanally_utraskill_b: <Italic>"A proper gang leader will give her goons some room to shine in the spotlight… I can't fight without my goons?! Ahem, are you having doubts about my strength?"</>
entries.nanally_skilldes::ga_nanally_utraskill_d: I'm way stronger than them! Deals <NumGreen>7</> instances of <Ling>Anima DMG</> immediately to surrounding enemies and summons Underboss to fight alongside her.<cf>Creates a small pull effect on surrounding enemies with Nanally's attacks while Underboss is active, and coordinates with all of Nanally's attacks to launch strikes, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</> that also counts as <TextHLT>follow-up attack</> damage.
entries.oneiror_skilldes::ga_oneiroi_melee1_des: Summons lambs to perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</>. Builds up <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">Imagination</> when attacks hit.
entries.oneiror_skilldes::ga_oneiroi_melee2_des: Hold Basic Attack to charge up, consuming <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">Imagination</> based on the charge duration to unleash up to 3 instances of Daydream, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</>.<cf>Hold Basic Attack during Reflexive Response, Bang!, Future Self Continuity, and 3.8-Billion-Year Mirage, consuming <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">Imagination</> to unleash the 3rd instance of Daydream, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</>.
entries.oneiror_skilldes::ga_oneiroi_melee3_des: Press Basic Attack while airborne to plunge, dealing 1 instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height by up to 100%. Builds up <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">Imagination</> on hit.
entries.oneiror_skilldes::ga_oneiroi_melee4_des: Triggers when using Basic Attack: Collaboration after a Critical Dodge. Throws Morpheus at the target, dealing 1 instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> and reducing Break. Builds up <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">Imagination</> on hit.
entries.oneiror_skilldes::ga_oneiroi_melee5_des: Hold Basic Attack again after Iroi uses Basic Attack: Daydream to consume <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">Imagination</>, summoning Morpheus to unleash sustained fire that deals <Ling>Anima DMG</>.
entries.oneiror_skilldes::ga_oneiroi_passive_1_b: <Italic>Sometimes, my shadow gets there before I do.</>
entries.oneiror_skilldes::ga_oneiroi_passive_1_d: <TextHLT>Blossom Enhancement</>: Generates a Vita Bud Copy when the current Vita Bud has existed for 3s. This copy cannot duplicate and does not count toward the Vita Bud limit. The copy produces 20 Copied Vita Pistils. Every 0.5s, one Copied Vita Pistil flies toward a target within range and explodes, dealing 37.5% of the original Vita Pistil's DMG.
entries.oneiror_skilldes::ga_oneiroi_passive_2_b: <Italic>My body lives on faithfully, covered in scars and never saying a word.</>
entries.oneiror_skilldes::ga_oneiroi_passive_2_d: Grants all team members an additional 5% DEF Ignore for 20s when performing healing.
entries.oneiror_skilldes::ga_oneiroi_passive_3_d: Interacts with small animals in the open world to obtain a random growth item, up to 3 times per day and 999 times in total.
entries.oneiror_skilldes::ga_oneiroi_qte_backgro: <Italic>Would you believe me if I said this is the sound of the Big Bang?</>
entries.oneiror_skilldes::ga_oneiroi_qte_des: Just in time! Picks up Morpheus and strikes forward, dealing 1 instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</>, healing all team members, and building up <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">Imagination</>.
entries.oneiror_skilldes::ga_oneiroi_skill_1_des: Press to activate. Summons lambs to heal all team members once and grant them an ATK bonus based on Iroi’s Base ATK.<cf>Summons three lambs to attack respectively, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</> and pulling in nearby enemies.<cf>Using this skill builds up <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">Imagination</>.
entries.oneiror_skilldes::ga_oneiroi_skill_2_des: Hold to activate. Creates dreamlike illusions during battle, causing 3 allies to enter the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes2">Regression</> state and assist in battle. Regression is automatically removed after leaving combat.
entries.oneiror_skilldes::ga_oneiroi_skill_3_des: While Iroi is on the team and in combat, any ally who falls enters the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes2">Regression</> state.<cf>Builds up <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">Imagination</> when any fallen ally enters the Regression state.
entries.oneiror_skilldes::ga_oneiroi_skill_backg: <Italic>I have to stay awake the night before my birthday. I believe that if I fall asleep, someone will come for the old me and leave a newly grown me in its place.</>
entries.oneiror_skilldes::ga_oneiroi_star1_des: Restores 3 Imagination per second while Iroi is off-field.<cf>Increases Imagination gain by 30% and grants Iroi maximum Imagination upon entering battle.
entries.oneiror_skilldes::ga_oneiroi_star2_des: Summons Morpheus, Icelos, or Phantasos at random when any ally casts a skill, performing 1 assist attack that deals DMG equal to 200% of Iroi's ATK. Restores all team members' HP by 120% of Iroi's ATK. Cooldown: 5s.
entries.oneiror_skilldes::ga_oneiroi_star4_des: Increases the ATK Ratio of lambs that replace allies in the Regression state:<cf>Morpheus:<cf>Sweet Dreams: up by 30%<cf>Deep Slumber: up by 30%.<cf><cf>Icelos:<cf>Little Prick: up by 30%<cf>Double Dose: up by 30%.<cf><cf>Phantasos:<cf>Lullaby Time: up by 30%<cf>Off-Key: up by 30%.
entries.oneiror_skilldes::ga_oneiroi_star5_des: Additional Sympathetic Nerves Effect: Increases all team members' ATK by 15% of Iroi's Base ATK for 20s.
entries.oneiror_skilldes::ga_oneiroi_star6_des: Grants 100% HP, 50 Cycle Energy, and 50 Ultimate Energy to the character revived after Iroi casts 3.8-Billion-Year Mirage.
entries.oneiror_skilldes::ga_oneiroi_starextra1_: Increases the skill level of Collaboration, Future Self Continuity, and 3.8-Billion-Year Mirage by 1.<cf>Increases all team members' DEF by 30% while Iroi is on the team.
entries.oneiror_skilldes::ga_oneiroi_starextra2_: Increases all team members' Crit DMG by 25% while Iroi is on the team. Increases Iroi's DMG dealt by 15% and Crit Rate by 5% for each ally in the Regression state.
entries.oneiror_skilldes::ga_oneiroi_ultraskill_: <Italic>I heard the bell at both ends of the dream: once at the beginning, once at the end. But the bell only rang once. From hydrothermal vents in the deep sea to skyscrapers on land, that awful chime has followed everything. Oh my, it's been ringing for 3.8 billion years.</>

Return to the first dream. Opens the gate to a dream and triggers different effects based on the amount of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">Imagination</> built up.<cf>If Imagination has not reached the required threshold: Iroi opens the Dream of the Horned Gate, continuously healing all allies.<cf>If Imagination has reached the required threshold: Iroi opens the Dream of the Ivory Gate, continuously healing all allies and dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</> to enemies inside the dream. During this time, press and hold the avatar of a team member in the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes2">Regression</> state to temporarily revive them and restore a portion of their HP. This effect can revive up to 1 character during each dream.<cf>The dream continuously consumes <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">Imagination</>. When Imagination is depleted, the dream ends, and the revived character returns to the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes2">Regression</> state.<cf>While the dream is active, <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">Imagination</> cannot be built up, but casting Daydream and Lucid Dream do not consume <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&OneiroiRes1">Imagination</>.
entries.sagiri_skilldes::ga_sagiri_melee1_des: Sakiri swings Kiroumaru and performs up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.
entries.sagiri_skilldes::ga_sagiri_melee2_des: Hold to activate <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&SagiriEat">Eating Mode</> with Kiroumaru. Mounts Sakiri onto Kiroumaru, allowing movement.<cf>Opens its mouth to continuously pull nearby targets within a cone while Hungry. Destroys movable objects in the scene and devours weak enemies.<cf>Takes <NumGreen>180s</> to digest <NumGreen>each</> devoured enemy, with only <NumGreen>1</> target digested at a time.<cf>Becomes Full when the number of enemies being digested reaches the limit, remaining movable but unable to pull or devour enemies.<cf>Release to exit the mode.
entries.sagiri_skilldes::ga_sagiri_melee3_des: Wields Kiroumaru in the air and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.
entries.sagiri_skilldes::ga_sagiri_melee_backgro: <Italic>According to Mr. T, an oddity who survived the depths of Kiroumaru's belly and lived to tell the tale thanks to Sakiri's timely intervention, hints at an unexpected perk: Amidst the gloom, one might unearth a half-digested game console to while away the hours—a quirky, entertaining twist to an otherwise harrowing wait for rescue.</>
entries.sagiri_skilldes::ga_sagiri_passive_1_bac: <Italic>It's not time to start yet! Instead of swallowing whole… wouldn't it be better to add more ingredients? Can't let the fun pass!</>
entries.sagiri_skilldes::ga_sagiri_passive_1_des: <TextHLT>Scorch Enhancement</>: Increases DoT taken by the target by 25% for each type of DoT effect while in Scorch state, up to 100%.
entries.sagiri_skilldes::ga_sagiri_passive_2_bac: <Italic>Those on the naughty list… will be taken by ghosts… or perhaps eaten?</>
entries.sagiri_skilldes::ga_sagiri_passive_2_des: Reduces enemies' DEF by 10% for 20s after inflicting Airborne or <TextHLT>Suppress</>.
entries.sagiri_skilldes::ga_sagiri_perfectevade_: Triggers when using Ram after a Critical Dodge. Leaps high into the air and strikes down hard with Kiroumaru against enemies left vulnerable by their missed attacks. Deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area and reduces Break.
entries.sagiri_skilldes::ga_sagiri_qte_backgroun: <Italic>Kiroumaru, stop right there! Hm? Did you just bump into something?</>
entries.sagiri_skilldes::ga_sagiri_qte_des: Let's see which unlucky soul is about to get squashed? Sakiri slams the enlarged Kiroumaru heavily onto the target, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area.
entries.sagiri_skilldes::ga_sagiri_skill1_des: Press to activate. Kiroumaru opens its mouth, pulling in nearby enemies. Kiroumaru then inflates and knocks down the enemy.
entries.sagiri_skilldes::ga_sagiri_skill2_des: Hold to activate. Kiroumaru opens its mouth, pulling in nearby enemies. Kiroumaru then bites through the ground, devouring the gravity in that area, levitating enemies there (not effective against powerful enemies).
entries.sagiri_skilldes::ga_sagiri_skill_backgro: <Italic>"Sa… Sakiri, can I eat this?" "Moron, next time ask before you eat!"</>
entries.sagiri_skilldes::ga_sagiri_star1_des: Extends the immovable effect inflicted by Feast of Gluttony to <NumGreen>6s</>.
entries.sagiri_skilldes::ga_sagiri_star2_des: Deals extra damage with Feast of Gluttony to airborne enemies, scaling with the target's mass and capped at <NumGreen>600%</> of ATK.
entries.sagiri_skilldes::ga_sagiri_star3_des: Increases Devour Whole and Feast of Gluttony damage by <NumGreen>6%</> for <NumGreen>each</> enemy defeated by the Team over the next <NumGreen>15s</>, up to <NumGreen>60%</>. Resets when out of combat.
entries.sagiri_skilldes::ga_sagiri_star4_des: Increases Team ATK (excluding Sakiri) by <NumGreen>30%</> of Sakiri's Base ATK for <NumGreen>20s</> after casting Feast of Gluttony.
entries.sagiri_skilldes::ga_sagiri_star5_des: Fully restores Feast of Gluttony's Ultimate Energy and resets its cooldown immediately when Devour Whole makes the target airborne.
entries.sagiri_skilldes::ga_sagiri_star6_des: Allows Kiroumaru to devour and digest up to <NumGreen>3</> enemies at a time in <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&SagiriEat">Eating Mode</>, with the digestion time for each enemy calculated independently.
entries.sagiri_skilldes::ga_sagiri_starextra1_de: Increases the skill level of Kiroumaru Headbutt, Devour Whole, and Feast of Gluttony by <NumGreen>1</>.
entries.sagiri_skilldes::ga_sagiri_starextra2_de: For each negative effect on the target, Sakiri deals <NumGreen>3%</> increased damage to the target, up to <NumGreen>12%</>.
entries.sagiri_skilldes::ga_sagiri_utraskill_bac: <Italic>No prey escapes before Kiroumaru has its fill.</>
entries.sagiri_skilldes::ga_sagiri_utraskill_des: No escaping this time! Kiroumaru spits out a large amount of Gravity Slurry from above, dealing <NumGreen>6</> instances of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area. Applies strong gravity to hit enemies, pressing them heavily to the ground (not effective against Bosses). Prevents <TextHLT>Suppressed</> enemies from moving for a period. Increases Team ATK (excluding Sakiri) based on Sakiri's Base ATK.
entries.shinku_skilldes::ga_shinku_melee1_1_des: Performs up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>. Grants <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuQEnergy">Defiant Spirit</> on hit.
entries.shinku_skilldes::ga_shinku_melee1_2_des: Press Basic Attack while airborne to plunge, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.
entries.shinku_skilldes::ga_shinku_melee1_3_des: Hold Basic Attack during the 3rd/4th/5th hit of Special Combat Arts to trigger Special Combat Arts (Altered), dealing <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> and granting <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuQEnergy">Defiant Spirit</> on hit.
entries.shinku_skilldes::ga_shinku_melee2_1_des: Performs up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>. Grants <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRageEEnergy">Fading Reason</> on hit.
entries.shinku_skilldes::ga_shinku_melee2_2_des: Press Basic Attack while airborne to plunge, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%. Grants <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRageEEnergy">Fading Reason</> on hit.
entries.shinku_skilldes::ga_shinku_melee2_3_des: Hold Basic Attack during the 3rd/4th/5th hit of Tidal Assault to trigger Tidal Assault (Scorn), dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> and granting <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRageEEnergy">Fading Reason</> on hit.
entries.shinku_skilldes::ga_shinku_melee_backgro: <Italic>"Tear through metal, smash through walls—when your own limbs are lethal weapons built for both offense and defense, why weigh yourself down with a weapon?"</>
entries.shinku_skilldes::ga_shinku_passive_1_bac: <Italic>"For Shinku as she is now, few situations are enough to make her go all out."</>
entries.shinku_skilldes::ga_shinku_passive_1_des: <TextHLT>Charge Enhancement</>: Grants off-field characters the same amount of Charge when the active character gains Ultimate Energy. While Shinku is active and in Charge state, each trigger deals AoE DMG equal to 400% of ATK (scales with Basic Attack level, reaching <NumGreen>863.6%</> at level 11), and increases her ATK by 5% for 30s, up to 10 stacks. Cooldown: 1s.
entries.shinku_skilldes::ga_shinku_passive_2_des: Increases Ultimate DMG against non-Boss enemies by <NumGreen>50%</>.
entries.shinku_skilldes::ga_shinku_passive_3_bac: <Italic>"Stay calm, Shinku. Don't let your instincts take over."</>
entries.shinku_skilldes::ga_shinku_passive_3_des: Enters the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuWatch">Menacing Gaze</> state when Shinku remains active in battle for more than 2s without actively initiating an attack, gaining stacks every second. Grants her <NumGreen>1</> additional stack of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuWatch">Menacing Gaze</> whenever Shinku successfully performs a Critical Dodge while this state is active.<cf><hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuWatch">Menacing Gaze</> stacks up to <NumGreen>8</> times. Switching characters removes the state and all stacks.<cf>Ends <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuWatch">Menacing Gaze</> when Shinku initiates an attack and hits, causing her to perform Instant Strike and deal bonus DMG in addition to the original attack. Each stack of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuWatch">Menacing Gaze</> increases this bonus DMG by <NumGreen>100%</> (scales with Basic Attack level, reaching <NumGreen>215.9%</> at level 11) and grants <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuQEnergy">Defiant Spirit</>, <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRageEEnergy">Fading Reason</>, and Cycle Energy.
entries.shinku_skilldes::ga_shinku_perfectevade2: Triggers when using Tidal Assault after a Critical Dodge. Retaliates against the target with a sharp kick, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>, reducing the target's Break, and gaining <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRageEEnergy">Fading Reason</>.<cf>Inflicts Forced Knockback and briefly stuns (not effective against Bosses) the target when Parry Attack or Critical Riposte hits while in the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuWatch">Menacing Gaze</> state, then deals 1 additional instance of DMG to the target equal to <NumGreen>20%</> of Instant Strike.
entries.shinku_skilldes::ga_shinku_perfectevade_: Triggers when using Special Combat Arts after a Critical Dodge. Retaliates against the target with a sharp kick, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>, reducing their Break, and gaining <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuQEnergy">Defiant Spirit</>.
entries.shinku_skilldes::ga_shinku_qte_backgroun: <Italic>"For a girl long used to fighting alone, learning to stand beside others marks a major step forward."</>
entries.shinku_skilldes::ga_shinku_qte_des: Enough already! Delivers a forceful knee strike, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> and gaining <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuQEnergy">Defiant Spirit</>.
entries.shinku_skilldes::ga_shinku_skill1_des: No time to catch your breath. Charges toward the target and launches a fierce assault, dealing multiple instances of <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> and gaining <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuQEnergy">Defiant Spirit</>.
entries.shinku_skilldes::ga_shinku_skill2_des: Consumes all <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRageEEnergy">Fading Reason</>. Leaps above the target into their blind spot and unleashes a powerful downward claw strike, dealing high <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>. Casts up to <NumGreen>5</> times during each <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRage">Surging Crimson</> state.
entries.shinku_skilldes::ga_shinku_skill_backgro: <Italic>"Let's end this quickly, before this gets any worse."</>
entries.shinku_skilldes::ga_shinku_star1_des: Shinku's damage ignores <NumGreen>12%</> of the target's DEF.
entries.shinku_skilldes::ga_shinku_star2_des: Reduces the target's Cosmos Resistance by <NumGreen>10%</> for <NumGreen>20</>s after the Ultimate hits.
entries.shinku_skilldes::ga_shinku_star3_des: Keeps <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuWatch">Menacing Gaze</> active after switching characters and allows Shinku to gain Menacing Gaze stacks while off-field.
entries.shinku_skilldes::ga_shinku_star4_des: Increases the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuWatch">Menacing Gaze</> stack cap to <NumGreen>16</> stacks. Enhances the triggered Instant Strike when <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuWatch">Menacing Gaze</> reaches <NumGreen>16</> stacks, granting it the additional effects of the Instant Strike triggered by Parry Attack or Critical Riposte: inflicts Forced Knockback on the target, briefly stuns (not effective against Bosses) them, and deals an additional instance of DMG equal to <NumGreen>20%</> of Instant Strike DMG.
entries.shinku_skilldes::ga_shinku_star5_des: Increases Shinku's DEF by <NumGreen>50%</> and Resistance to Interruptions by <NumGreen>50%</> during <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRage">Surging Crimson</>, and recovers HP equal to 300% of her Base ATK after casting Scarlet Descent.
entries.shinku_skilldes::ga_shinku_star6_des: Increases Shinku's damage ratios for Scarlet Descent, Crimson Judgment, and Dragonflame Verdict by <NumGreen>30%</>, and allows Scarlet Descent and Crimson Judgment to pull in targets within range.
entries.shinku_skilldes::ga_shinku_starextra1_de: Increases the skill level of Basic Attack, Redirect Skill, and Ultimate by <NumGreen>1</>. Increases DMG dealt by an additional <NumGreen>30%</> while in <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRage">Surging Crimson</>.
entries.shinku_skilldes::ga_shinku_starextra2_de: Increases Shinku's Crit Rate by <NumGreen>10%</> and causes her damage to ignore <NumGreen>15%</> of the target's DEF.
entries.shinku_skilldes::ga_shinku_ultraskill1_d: Don't think you can pull something like that and escape unscathed… Consumes all <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuQEnergy">Defiant Spirit</> to enter the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRage">Surging Crimson</> state, then launches multiple attacks, dealing high <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to the target.<cf>Replaces Special Combat Arts with Tidal Assault and High-Speed Breach with Scarlet Descent while in Surging Crimson state. Increases DMG dealt and Resistance to Interruptions, greatly boosts Movement, and lasts for <NumGreen>13</>s. Ends <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRage">Surging Crimson</> when switching characters.<cf>Hold Dodge while moving to partially release her Esper Ability and greatly boost Movement.
entries.shinku_skilldes::ga_shinku_ultraskill2_d: Casts Crimson Judgment when <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRage">Surging Crimson</> is about to end. Press Ultimate repeatedly to dash rapidly between targets, dealing high <Guang>Cosmos DMG</>.<cf>Grants <NumGreen>1</> additional instance of Crimson Judgment for <NumGreen>each</> use of Scarlet Descent during <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRage">Surging Crimson</>. Can be cast up to <NumGreen>3</> times during each <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRage">Surging Crimson</> state.
entries.shinku_skilldes::ga_shinku_ultraskill3_d: Press Ultimate again to cast Dragonflame Verdict after all uses of Crimson Judgment have been consumed or after <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ShinkuRage">Surging Crimson</> ends, dealing massive <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to targets in a large area.
entries.shinku_skilldes::ga_shinku_ultraskill_ba: <Italic>"It will hurt—for her enemies, and for her as well."</>
entries.skia_skilldes::ga_skia_melee1_des: Performs up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks using steady martial arts techniques, dealing <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</>.<cf>Splits <NumGreen>1</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</> from his shadow to pursue <NumGreen>each</> target hit. Locks each target with up to <NumGreen>3</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrusts</> simultaneously.
entries.skia_skilldes::ga_skia_melee2_des: Strikes in the air and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.
entries.skia_skilldes::ga_skia_melee3_des: Splitting from Skia's shadow, these shattered shadows resemble the fangs of a giant beast. entries.skia_skilldes::ga_skia_melee_background: <Italic>"The doggo… This dark stuff comes out with doggo punches… pretty impressive."</>
entries.skia_skilldes::ga_skia_passive_1_backgro: <Italic>Usually, there's no need for physical intervention—Skia can subdue targets with just his shadows, keeping facilities undamaged. Plus, he helps with cleanup… According to a BAC cafeteria survey, 84% of staff welcome Skia at their work site—less hassle for them!</>
entries.skia_skilldes::ga_skia_passive_1_des: <TextHLT>Remora Enhancement</>: Inflicts an additional Remora on a target when <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</> locks onto them in Remora state.
entries.skia_skilldes::ga_skia_passive_2_backgro: <Italic>Your body might be free to move, but your shadow is held in an iron grip, rendering you immobile… Quite the peculiar sensation.</>
entries.skia_skilldes::ga_skia_passive_2_des: Increases <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</> damage by <NumGreen>10%</> for <NumGreen>15s</> after casting The Pack, including collision damage in <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill2">Shadow Hound Gnaw</> mode.
entries.skia_skilldes::ga_skia_passive_3_backgro: <Italic>Fadia once asked Skia what position his body feels like when submerged in shadows. Unable to describe it, Skia told her to use her imagination. He'd rather not know what images that sparked in her mind.</>
entries.skia_skilldes::ga_skia_passive_3_des: Hold Movement and Dodge to enter Shadow Hound mode<cf><cf>Shadow Hound<cf>Lurks within his shadow, allowing movement on ground and wall surfaces.<cf>Cannot be detected by enemies.<cf>Grants immunity to certain attacks, but ends if hit by ground damage.<cf>Press Basic Attack or switch characters to cancel.<cf>Reaching the edge of elevated positions and moving forward also cancels the mode.
entries.skia_skilldes::ga_skia_perfectevade_des: Triggers when using Arresting Art after a Critical Dodge. Strikes enemies with ink-splash shadows, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area and reducing Break.
entries.skia_skilldes::ga_skia_qte_des: The relentless shadows cannot be shaken off. Commands the shadow like a police canine to bite the target, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area.
entries.skia_skilldes::ga_skia_skill_background: <Italic>Some nimble troublemakers might think they can escape ETD's pursuit… They should check what's lurking beneath their feet.</>
entries.skia_skilldes::ga_skia_skill_des: A workflow designed for pursuit. Enters the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill1">Tailed</> state, leaps into own shadow, and deals <NumGreen>6</> instances of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area. Splits 3 <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrusts</> from shadow for each target hit, then enters <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill2">Shadow Hound Gnaw</> mode.<cf><cf><hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill1">Tailed</><cf>Prevents <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrusts</> from disappearing after dealing damage to targets during the state.<cf><cf><hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill2">Shadow Hound Gnaw</><cf>Allows movement on ground or wall surfaces, similar to Shadow Hound mode.<cf>Remains undetected when approaching enemy targets.<cf>Grants immunity to certain attacks, but cancels the mode when hit by ground damage.<cf>Triggers additional attacks from <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrusts</> whenever touching an enemy already marked by <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">them</>.<cf>Press Basic Attack or switch characters to exit this mode during its duration.<cf>Moves forward at the edge of a high place to end this mode.<cf>Deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area upon exiting the mode.
entries.skia_skilldes::ga_skia_star1_des: Increses the auto-attack DMG Ratio for <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</> by <NumGreen>60%</>.
entries.skia_skilldes::ga_skia_star2_des: Increases Skia's Crit Chance by <NumGreen>10%</> and Resistance to Interruptions by <NumGreen>50%</> for <NumGreen>15s</> after casting Shadow Hound Chase.
entries.skia_skilldes::ga_skia_star3_des: Skia's damage to targets locked by <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</> is increased by <NumGreen>4%</>.<cf>If only one target is locked onto by <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</> on the field, Skia's damage to it is further increased by <NumGreen>4%</>.
entries.skia_skilldes::ga_skia_star4_des: Extends the duration of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill1">Tailed</> to <NumGreen>12s</>. Increases Attachment DMG by 2% per second a target is <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&attach">attached</>, up to 40%.
entries.skia_skilldes::ga_skia_star5_des: Increases the target's mass by <NumGreen>50</> and reduces its Movement Speed by <NumGreen>20%</> for each <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</> locked onto it.
entries.skia_skilldes::ga_skia_star6_des: Increases the Extra DMG Ratio of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</> by <NumGreen>20%</> while in <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill2">Shadow Hound Gnaw</> mode when touching an enemy locked onto by <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</>.
entries.skia_skilldes::ga_skia_starextra1_des: Increases the skill level of Arresting Art, Shadow Hound Chase, and The Pack by <NumGreen>1</>.
entries.skia_skilldes::ga_skia_starextra2_des: Reduces the locked-on target's Lakshana Resistance by 2% per <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</>, up to 6%.
entries.skia_skilldes::ga_skia_utraskill_des: A workflow designed for suppression. Throws a spinning lighter, causing his shadow to spread across the ground in all directions, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area.<cf>Converges multiple shadows on a single location like well-trained canines, dealing <NumGreen>3</> instances of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area.<cf>Increases <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</>'s damage after casting The Pack (including collision damage in <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill2">Shadow Hound Gnaw</> mode) and inflicts a control effect on targets with each attack.

entries.zankou_skilldes::ga_zankou_melee1_des: Wields her blade and performs up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks while in Reality Form, dealing <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>. Pulls in targets within range on the 5th instance of Basic Attack. Gains the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouShou">Hunt</> buff for the attack's duration.
entries.zankou_skilldes::ga_zankou_melee2_des: Wields her blade to pull the silk and performs up to <NumGreen>4</> consecutive attacks while in Illusion Form, dealing <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> and inflicting <NumGreen>1</> stack of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouDot">Heartwrench</> on hit. Pulls in targets within range on the 3rd instance of Basic Attack. Each Nightmare Waltz attack spreads up to <NumGreen>4</> DoT effects from the target to all enemies in the area, including the original target. Gains the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouHuo">Delusion</> buff for the attack's duration. The DMG dealt by Nightmare Waltz counts as Follow-up Attack DMG.
entries.zankou_skilldes::ga_zankou_melee3_des: Hold Basic Attack during the <NumGreen>1st</> or <NumGreen>2nd</> stage of Wildfire while in Reality Form to trigger Flickering Shadow, dealing <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.
entries.zankou_skilldes::ga_zankou_melee4_des: Hold Basic Attack during the <NumGreen>1st</> or <NumGreen>2nd</> stage of Nightmare Waltz while in Illusion Form to trigger Moonfall, dealing <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>. Inflicts <NumGreen>1</> stack of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouDot">Heartwrench</> on hit. The DMG dealt by Moonfall counts as Follow-up Attack DMG.
entries.zankou_skilldes::ga_zankou_melee5_des: Press Basic Attack while airborne to plunge, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> in an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height by up to 100%.
entries.zankou_skilldes::ga_zankou_melee_backgro: <Italic>The nightmare drifts in, and despair burns from within.</>
entries.zankou_skilldes::ga_zankou_passive_1_bac: <Italic>Countless flames merge into a silent sun, burning every gaze into the same hue.</>
entries.zankou_skilldes::ga_zankou_passive_1_des: <TextHLT>Scorch Enhancement</>: Scorch can be stacked up to <NumGreen>3</> times. For <NumGreen>each</> DoT effect allies inflict on a target afflicted with Scorch, Zankou inflicts <NumGreen>1</> stack of Scorch on them, replacing the DMG, type, and duration of existing Scorch on the target with those of the newly inflicted effect. Scorch inflicted by this effect cannot trigger it again.
entries.zankou_skilldes::ga_zankou_passive_2_bac: <Italic>Lose yourself in the intoxicating crimson of her gaze, and never wake again.</>
entries.zankou_skilldes::ga_zankou_passive_2_des: Sets Zankou's Cycle Energy to <NumGreen>100</> upon entering battle. Cooldown: <NumGreen>30</>s. Triggers only <NumGreen>once</> per battle. Increases Zankou's Cycle Intensity by <NumGreen>100</> while she is on the team.
entries.zankou_skilldes::ga_zankou_passive_3_bac: <Italic>It began with a fleeting glance. Then the world slowly blurred away.</>
entries.zankou_skilldes::ga_zankou_passive_3_des: "Beyond sight. Beyond reach."<cf>Enters Invisible state for <NumGreen>20</>s upon using the special skill Lost Focus while out of combat. Increases Movement Speed by <NumGreen>50%</> while in Invisible state and prevents enemies from detecting Zankou.
entries.zankou_skilldes::ga_zankou_perfectevade_: Press Basic Attack after a Critical Dodge to deal <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> and reduce Break.
entries.zankou_skilldes::ga_zankou_qte_des: Wields her blade to attack, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.
entries.zankou_skilldes::ga_zankou_skill1_des: Switches to Illusion Form after successfully casting Sanguine Dash while in Reality Form. Enables an enhanced Sanguine Dash for a set time after the <NumGreen>4th</> or <NumGreen>5th</> stage of Wildfire, Flickering Shadow, or Voidstep. Inflicts <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouDot">Heartwrench</> on targets hit and triggers <TextHLT>Disarray</>, reducing massive Break of enemies in a large area. Delays the removal of the Reality Form <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouShou">Hunt</> effect when switching to Illusion Form with Sanguine Dash. Prevents the form switch if the skill is interrupted before it is complete.
entries.zankou_skilldes::ga_zankou_skill2_des: Switches to Reality Form after successfully casting Soulcross while in Illusion Form. Enables an enhanced Soulcross shortly before Illusion Form ends. Deals massive DMG to enemies in a large area, inflicts <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouDot">Heartwrench</> on targets hit, and triggers <TextHLT>Oblivion</>, activating Bloodfeast Reverie.<cf>Grants Illusion Form for a set duration. Ends Illusion Form and returns Zankou to Reality Form when Soulcross or Bloodfeast Reverie is successfully cast, when its duration expires, or when Zankou leaves the field. Delays the removal of the Illusion Form <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouHuo">Delusion</> effect when switching to Reality Form with Soulcross. Counts all DMG dealt by Soulcross and its enhanced version as Follow-up Attack DMG. Prevents the form switch if the skill is interrupted before it is complete.
entries.zankou_skilldes::ga_zankou_skill_backgro: <Italic>No need to wake up yet. The nightmare is only beginning.</>
entries.zankou_skilldes::ga_zankou_star1_des: Allows Wildfire, Flickering Shadow, Voidstep, enhanced Sanguine Dash, and enhanced Soulcross to spread DoT effects upon Awakening. Grants Zankou <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouShou">Hunt</> and <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouHuo">Delusion</> at all times. Keeps both buffs active without delayed removal and prevents them from being removed when Zankou leaves the field or switches forms. Removes them only when Zankou is defeated.<cf>The DMG bonus granted to Zankou by <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouShou">Hunt</> increases to <NumGreen>40%</>. The DoT Crit DMG bonus granted to the whole team by <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouHuo">Delusion</> increases to <NumGreen>50%</>.
entries.zankou_skilldes::ga_zankou_star2_des: Builds up <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouStack">Kindling</> whenever Zankou participates in a Cycle that triggers Scorch or Hexed, increasing the Final DMG dealt by the next Inferno Flamenco by <NumGreen>150%</>. Allows <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouStack">Kindling</> to accumulate even before Inferno Flamenco becomes available, up to 1 stack.
entries.zankou_skilldes::ga_zankou_star3_des: <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouShou">Hunt</> increases Zankou's Resistance to Interruptions by an additional <NumGreen>50%</>. <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouHuo">Delusion</> restores HP equal to <NumGreen>4%</> of her Max HP per second.
entries.zankou_skilldes::ga_zankou_star4_des: Activates Bloodfeast Reverie immediately when Inferno Flamenco becomes available.<cf>Applies the DMG Bonus from <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouStack">Kindling</> to Bloodfeast Reverie, which shares the same <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouStack">Kindling</> stacks with Inferno Flamenco.
entries.zankou_skilldes::ga_zankou_star5_des: Guarantees that the first Breakable target hit by enhanced Sanguine Dash enters the Broken state. Triggers only <NumGreen>once</> per target per battle and does not affect bosses in Character Balance Mode.<cf>Increases all allies' Break DMG by <NumGreen>300%</> while Zankou is on the team.
entries.zankou_skilldes::ga_zankou_star6_des: Increases the DMG dealt by the <NumGreen>final</> hit of <TextHLT>Oblivion</> to a single target by <NumGreen>12%</> for each DoT stack on that target, up to <NumGreen>240%</>. Calculates the DMG Bonus separately for each target when multiple targets are hit, based on the total number of DoT stacks on each target.
entries.zankou_skilldes::ga_zankou_starextra1_de: Increases the skill levels of Wildfire, Nightmare Waltz, Sanguine Dash, Soulcross, Inferno Flamenco, and Bloodfeast Reverie by <NumGreen>1</>. Increases the DMG Ratios of Bloodfeast Reverie and Inferno Flamenco by <NumGreen>20%</>.
entries.zankou_skilldes::ga_zankou_starextra2_de: Increases Zankou's ATK by <NumGreen>40%</> for <NumGreen>20</>s after she deals damage. This effect does not stack. Resets the duration when triggered again.<cf>Grants an enhanced effect for <NumGreen>60</>s when a target afflicted with Scorch is defeated. Maxes out the target's Scorch stacks whenever Zankou inflicts DoTs on them during the enhancement. Refreshes the enhancement's duration whenever another target afflicted with Scorch is defeated.
entries.zankou_skilldes::ga_zankou_ultraskill_ba: <Italic>The soul's flame dies within the dream, slipping into a sleep with no need to wake.</>
entries.zankou_skilldes::ga_zankou_utraskill_des: Press to cast the Ultimate when Ultimate Energy is full. Has <NumGreen>2</> Ultimates: Inferno Flamenco and Bloodfeast Reverie.<cf>Casts Inferno Flamenco if Bloodfeast Reverie is inactive.<cf>Prioritizes Bloodfeast Reverie if it is active. Counts DMG dealt by Bloodfeast Reverie as Follow-up Attack DMG and inflicts <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ZankouUltraDot">Vile Ash</> on enemies in a large area. Enables one enhanced Inferno Flamenco to be cast without consuming Ultimate Energy within a limited time after successfully casting Bloodfeast Reverie. Removes this cast opportunity when the time limit expires.
